author: Access Now
title: From surveillance to governance: recentering human rights in the UN AI agenda
content:
September 21


				 @


				9:00 am


					 –


					10:30 am


EDT


Hybrid side event during UNGA81 High-Level Week


In-person attendance available upon request: email

un@accessnow.org


join the livestream


 Add to Calendar


 Google


 Apple


 Outlook 365


 Outlook Live


Panelists:


Louise Lund Henneberg

, Acting Director/Techplomacy, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Denmark


Wafa Ben Hassine

, Chief, Digital Technology and Human Rights Section, Rule of Law, Accountability and Civic Space, Oﬀice of the High Commissioner for Human Rights


Beatriz Busaniche

, Executive Director, Fundación Vía Libre


Luda Svystunova

, Head of Social Research, Amundi


Moderator:


Alejandro Mayoral Baños

, Co-Executive Director, Access Now


During the first session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance, governments and stakeholders convened to have open, transparent and inclusive discussions on artificial intelligence governance. We now gather experts across the spectrum of stakeholders during UNGA81 to reaffirm that human rights should be the stepping stone of this process, instead of an afterthought.


None of this is irreversible, but the security issues associated with advanced AI tools are the consequences of deliberately prioritizing profit and competitiveness over the security and safety of at-risk communities, and they will not resolve on their own. Unbridled AI adoption combined with unacceptably lax corporate security practices demands urgent intervention at all levels, starting from putting human rights back at the center of digital governance mechanisms.


This discussion has the objective to explore concrete, actionable ways in which each stakeholder can contribute to oppose the normalization of surveillance. Experts will also discuss how to chart a way forward to reaffirm digital rights as the natural first line of defense against the abuses of AI technologies.

Artikel vom 2. April 2018 von und bei Stefan Sell

Migrantinnen in der Pflege: “Niemand überwacht die Arbeitsbedingungen” in Privathaushalten

 und hier zur internationalen An-/Abwerbung:


Einwanderung von Fachkräften: Pflegeverband fordert Tempo bei Work and Stay Agentur 


„Deutschland braucht dringend Pfleger*innen, doch einwanderungwillige Fachkräfte haben es schwer. Ein katholischer Sozialverband fordert jetzt Reformen.


Immer mehr Menschen in Deutschland sind auf Pflege angewiesen. Entsprechend riesig ist der Personalbedarf der Branche. Doch obwohl viele ausgebildete Pflegekräfte aus anderen Ländern gern nach Deutschland kommen wollen, tut die Bundesregierung kaum etwas dafür, ihnen den Weg zu ebnen. Am Donnerstag richtete deshalb der Verband katholischer Altenhilfe in einem Pressegespräch deutliche Forderungen an die Politik. Verbandsgeschäftsführer Andreas Wedeking betonte: „Jede fünfte Pflegefachkraft hat inzwischen einen ausländischen Hintergrund.“ Doch Zehntausende weitere versuchten jedes Jahr erfolglos, nach Deutschland zu kommen, denn auch nach der Reform des Fachkräfteeinwanderungsgesetzes 2024 seien die Hürden weiter hoch. Um das zu ändern, forderte Wedeking insbesondere eine effektive Work and Stay Agentur, die Visaverfahren, Anrechnung von Berufsabschlüssen und Ankommenshilfe zentralisieren, vereinheitlichen und digitalisieren soll. Eine solche Work and Stay Agentur ist tatsächlich von der Bundesregierung geplant, allerdings lässt sich das zuständige Arbeits- und Sozialministerium von Bärbel Bas (SPD) mit der Umsetzung bisher Zeit. (…) Sinken sollten dabei auch die Kosten, sowohl für die angeworbenen Pfleger*innen als auch für die Träger. Letztere geben mittlerweile große Summen dafür aus, die Angeworbenen auf ihrem Weg durch die bürokratischen Prozesse zu unterstützen. Und wer monatelang in Anrechnungsprozessen steckt, fällt so lange weitgehend als Arbeitskraft aus. Die Kosten, die hier für die Trägereinrichtungen entstehen, würden sich direkt in dem niederschlagen, was Bewohner*innen, Angehörige und Versicherungen für einen Platz im Pflegeheim bezahlen müssen. Der Pflegeverband fordert des Weiteren eine Positivliste für Berufsabschlüsse aus bestimmten Ländern, die dann ohne weitere Überprüfung anerkannt würden. (…) Neben den bürokratischen Hürden kommen noch gesamtgesellschaftliche Probleme hinzu, die neu eingereisten Fachkräften besonders zu schaffen machen. Dazu gehörten etwa die anhaltende Wohnungskrise oder die schlechte Verkehrsanbindung auf dem Land. Hier müsse die Bundesregierung konkrete Verbesserungen schaffen – nicht nur für die eingewanderten Pfleger*innen, aber eben auch für sie.“

author: heinhtetkyaw
title: The Marxist Roots of Japanese Fascism
content:
The emergence of fascism in Japan in the inter-war era is often seen as an anti-modern, authoritarian and traditionalist backlash against the political concepts of the West. Yet, historical evidence shows that the theory behind Japanese radical ultranationalism and fascism was developed on the basis of European socialist, Marxist and anarcho-syndicalist doctrines. Instead of forming opposite ends of an ideological spectrum, radical leftist theory and state-oriented ultranationalism merged in the Taishō (1912-1926) and early Shōwa eras under the impact of a similar perception of crisis.

Disillusionment with the concept of “Taishō democracy,” dramatic changes caused by capitalist industrialization and vulnerability on the international arena compelled a wide array of Japanese theorists to seek radical, state-oriented solutions[1]. Using the example of Takabatake Motoyuki, Uesugi Shinkichi, Kanokogi Kazunobu, as well as the later tenkō (ideological conversion) movement among members of the Japanese Communist Party, we can see that socialist doctrine gave impetus to totalitarian militarism in Japan. The development of national socialist and proto-fascist ideologies in Japan occurred in conjunction with the crises of the Japanese capitalist system. The period following the Meiji Restoration was characterized by rapid state-guided industrialization and the formation of what is known as “dual economy”.

The link between Marxism and Japanese fascism on a theoretical level has been pioneered by Takabatake Motoyuki (1886-1928). A former political activist in the Meiji socialist movement, Takabatake shifted towards serious study of Marxist theory in the “winter period” that followed the state repression associated with the High Treason Case of 1910-1911. Takabatake published the first full Japanese translation of Karl Marx's Capital in 1919. In the same year, however, inspired by the Bolshevik Revolution of 1917, Takabatake parted company with socialist leaders such as Yamakawa Hitoshi and Sakai Toshihiko to elaborate his doctrine of Marxian national or state socialism (kokka shakai-shugi) [2]. The genius of Takabatake Motoyuki was in accepting Marxist economics while thoroughly rewriting Marx's theory of the state. Takabatake believed that Marx had a split personality: as an economist Marx was a great scientist, yet as a theorist he was wrong and unscientific because he was too much an emotion-driven utopian when he predicted the disappearance of the state through “withering away” after proletarian revolution. Based on his Hobbesian conception of human nature, Takabatake claimed that humans were egoistic and antisocial, thus making public tōsei – domination, authority and control – a supra-class and supra-historical necessity for all stages of human civilization[3]. Domination preceded economic exploitation, according to Takabatake. The state was not only an executive body of the ruling class, but a constant institution needed for cohesion of society. Thus, a “proletarian state” that was supposed to disappear was a logical paradox confirmed in practice by the authoritarian centralization of power in Soviet Russia controlled by the Bolsheviks. Instead of a stateless utopia, Takabatake supported “functional statism”. Takabatake proposed to utilize Marxian economic planning through elimination of private capitalism, state control of finance and industry, and centralization of production in the context of strong militarized national state. Importantly, Takabatake insisted that this type of state socialism had to be suited for the national character of Japan. He substituted Marxist class struggle with minzokuteki unity of the nation, which he considered more authentic than class consciousness based on historical, cultural and racial sentiment. Moreover, Takabatake added the imperial institution to his formula of state socialism. Takabatake maintained that the monarchy was the most natural and fitting form of state authority for the Japanese kokumin (nation). In international politics, Takabatake demanded universal military conscription and national defense as protection of Japan against encirclement by the West and “workers' imperialism” of the Soviets. This formula of Takabatake's Marxian national socialism created a very influential model, spawning a number of radical rightwing political parties such as Taikakai, Ishikawa Junjūrō's National-Socialist Party of Great Japan, Tsukui Tatsuo's Patriotic Labor Party, and the fascist …

author: Dominic Gutoman
title: Ombudsman dismisses human rights complaints vs military even without hearing
content:
Jhed Tamano and Jonila Castro. (Photo courtesy of Hands Off Jhed & Jonila Network)

Trigger warning: Description of state violence, torture, enforced disappearance

MANILA – For two years, not a single hearing was done on the torture and enforced disappearance complaints filed by environmental defenders Jonila Castro and Jhed Tamano against military officials before the Office of the Ombudsman. Despite this, the case was dismissed.

“Two years. No hearings. Then dismissal,” Kalikasan said in a statement. “Instead of reckoning with the evidence provided by the [victim] environmental defenders, the Ombudsman gave greater weight to the accounts of security officials and invoked the presumption of regularity in their favor.”

Tamano and Castro were affiliated with the Alyansa para sa Pagtatanggol sa Kabuhayan, Paninirahan, at Kalikasan ng Manila Bay (AKAP KA Manila Bay) when they were abducted on September 2, 2023 while conducting consultation and research with fishing communities affected by the Manila Bay reclamation projects.

Read: 2 environmental activists defy military, expose abduction

The two later appeared at a press conference on September 19, 2023 organized by the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) which claimed that they were rebel returnees. In front of government officials and military forces, they revealed during the press conference that they were abducted by state security agents.

The cases filed against the state security officials were arbitrary detention, grave coercion, torture, enforced disappearance, grave misconduct, grave abuse of authority, oppression, and prejudicial conduct.

“The abduction of Tamano and Castro represents just one case among hundreds of victims of state-sponsored violence,” Kalikasan said. “[It] is not an isolated case but a deliberate strategy—and we will not allow it to go unchallenged.”

The Ombudsman ruled in favor of the accused state security officials, stating that survivors “failed to discharge such quantum of proofs needed to establish prima facie evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction and substantial evidence against all respondents.”

The Ombudsman decided with only the affidavits submitted by the complainants (Castro and Tamano) and the respondents, namely National Security Council (NSC) Assistant Director General Jonathan Malaya; National Intelligence Coordinating Agency (NICA) Regional Director Niño Balagtas; 70th Infantry Battalion – Philippine Army (IBPA) Commanding Officer Ronnel Dela Cruz and his members Junrey Caballeda, Sherwin Momo, Justin Gutierrez, Manny Trinidad Timbol; several members of the 70th IBPA; aliases “Allan,” “Jak,” “CJ,” and “Bryan”; retired military officials Mario Jose Chico and Mark Leo Santos, both affiliated to the NTF-ELCAC; and Philippine National Police (PNP) officers Carlito Buco, Jr. and Silvestre Colanza.

Read: After being released from military custody, 2 activists vow to continue fight vs reclamation

Read: Victims of abduction recount how and why they lived with Bataan coastal communities

The Ombudsman said that the evidence presented by Castro and Tamano “failed to prove” their accusations. The pieces of evidence scrutinized by the Ombudsman were (1) the logo of the 70th Infantry Battalion on the laptop of one of their interrogators reported by Castro, (2) the admission of their interrogators that they are affiliated with the military, police, and the NTF-ELCAC, and (3) the presence of Justin Gutierrez, who introduced himself as a soldier implicated for inquiring about Castro’s whereabouts, and a certain “Bryan” who was among those who guarded the two during their abduction, at the camp of the 70th Infantry Battalion.

“Other than these, the complainants (Castro and Tamano) failed to submit any concrete evidence supporting their assertion that their abduction and detention were perpetrated by the agents of the state,” the Ombudsman said.

The Ombudsman also stated that between the conflicting narratives, the office gives more credence to the testimonies of the military officials because it ruled that the statements of Castro and Tamano are contradictory for insisting to identify that their abductors are soldiers from the 70th Infantry Battalion.

author: Simon Childs
title: Reform MP in Hypocrisy Row After Rightwing Think Tank Flies Him to Italy
content:
A Reform MP who rails against foreign influence in British politics was accused of “absurd hypocrisy” after accepting a trip to Italy paid for by a Dutch think tank.


In July, Danny Kruger took the all-expenses paid trip courtesy of the Center for European Renewal (CER), a pan-European rightwing organisation, based in the Netherlands, which says it is dedicated to “the Western ideal of a civilised, humane and free society”. The CER has ties to the former far-right, authoritarian government of Viktor Orbán, which ruled Hungary from 2010 until he was finally dislodged in an election in April this year.


The Dutch-based organisation spent £724.24 on his flights, hotel and meals over the course of the two-day trip from 8 to 9 July, according to the parliamentary register of members’ financial interests. He claimed the purpose of his visit was to “attend a day-long discussion of global affairs”.


The CER organises an annual meeting called the “Vanenburg conference”, named after the Dutch town in which it was first held. It is unclear whether this is the event Kruger attended – neither Kruger, Reform UK nor CER responded to a request for comment.


Only months before his jaunt to Italy,

Kruger spoke in the House of Commons

, alleging “glaring foreign interference” in the Gorton and Denton by-election.


In the March 2026 debate on the Representation of the People Bill, he claimed that votes had been cast under coercion through “family voting”. He went on to say that Asian voters in the UK were “taking their orders on how to vote from mosques and from clans – often directly from Pakistan.” The Green party’s Hannah Spencer won the 26 February byelection with 40.7% of the vote, compared with 28.7% for Reform’s Matthew Goodwin. A police investigation into claims of family voting

found “no evidence”.


On 28 August, Kruger tabled a series of proposed amendments to the bill, saying: “Recent changes in the makeup of Britain now jeopardise our democracy.”


Kruger’s amendments include removing the right to vote from Commonwealth citizens who are not British, limiting postal voting to diplomats and members of the Armed Forces and restricting election material to English, Welsh and languages “native to the British Isles”.


But Kruger appears to be more relaxed about some forms of so-called foreign influence than others.


CER is a Dutch non-profit organisation which “seeks to nurture in successive generations of Europeans an understanding of and devotion to the truth and wisdom embedded in the Western intellectual and moral tradition.” A key part of its programme is its Vanenburg conference, at which conservatives are encouraged to gather to exchange views and discuss the issues of the day.


CER also has a significant historical connection with the European Conservative, a rightwing magazine based in Budapest. The publication is funded by the Batthyány Lajos Foundation (BLA),

a non-profit through which

the former Hungarian government under Orbán used to channel funds to favoured projects. In 2021, its editor, Albino Mario-Fantiti,

said the magazine

 “grew out of the activities” of the CER. In 2022, it was

pulled from

 WH Smiths after it published a description of LGBT Pride month as “an opportunity to publicly parade some of the more dissolute aspects of human experience”.


Good Law Project policy advisor Cat MacLean said: “It’s not the first time Reform has been caught up in a foreign influence story and once again, the hypocrisy here is truly absurd.


“Kruger will happily allow a Dutch think tank with links to the Hungarian far-right to fly him out to Italy, and meanwhile, he refers to British citizens exercising their democratic rights as ‘foreign influence’, simply because they are Muslim.”


The revelation comes after a summer of scandal for Reform. The Metropolitan Police is investigating the party after a

Channel 4 News exposé

 showed two senior party figures discussing ways to take £500,000 and donations in kind from an actor posing as a wealthy American businessman. Foreign donations are illegal under electoral law. Nigel Farage’s senior aide Dan Jukes and Reform’s head of policy James Orr stepped down pending the outcome of an internal investigation.


There have also been questions over Farage’s personal finances, including an

undeclared gift of £5m

 from Thailand based crypto-billionaire Christopher Harborne.

title: How to Understand Key Terms in Large Language Models
content:
When you use AI to write, read reports, or work with files, you may encounter terms such as

token

,

context

, and

agent

. These terms help explain what happens when you give an AI application a task: what information it can use, how it produces a response, and whether it can take actions such as searching for sources or saving a document.


This guide introduces the main terms related to

large language models (LLMs)

 through practical examples. It begins with how models process information, then explains how to give them instructions and reference material, how tools and agents carry out tasks, and how to organise ongoing work. It also introduces ways to access models through other software or run them on your own equipment.


1.  How Language Models Work


Large Language Models


A

large language model (LLM)

 is an AI model trained on vast amounts of text and other data to learn patterns in language. ‘Large’ refers to its scale, including the number of internal parameters adjusted during training.


When generating text, a typical LLM uses the information available to it – including your instructions and the text already written – to predict what could come next. More precisely, it predicts the next

token

, a small unit of text such as a word or part of a word. It selects a token, adds it to the text, and repeats the process. In this way, it builds a response step by step.


Many people first encounter LLMs through a question-and-answer conversation. But the same process also allows models to summarise documents, translate, and draft text. A fluent response, however, is not necessarily a correct one: generating plausible language does not guarantee factual accuracy.


Token


A

token

 is a small unit of text that a language model processes. Before your message reaches the model, a tool called a

tokeniser

 splits it into tokens. A token may be a whole word, part of a word, or a punctuation mark. Spaces can also form part of a token.


For example, a tokeniser might keep ‘cat’ as one token but split ‘playing’ into ‘play’ and ‘ing’. This is an illustration, not a fixed rule: different tokenisers can split the same text differently. A token is therefore not the same thing as a word, and counting words will not give you an exact token count.


Each token is assigned a numerical ID so that the model can process the text as numbers. When generating a reply, the model predicts tokens one at a time. These tokens are then converted back into the text you see on screen.


Token counts matter when using a model.

Input tokens

 are the tokens in the material supplied to it, such as your instructions, documents, and any earlier messages included in the conversation.

Output tokens

 are the tokens it generates. Many model providers charge for API use based on these counts, often at different rates for input and output. Models also have limits on how many tokens they can process or generate in one request.


Longer texts generally require more tokens. The language also makes a difference: expressing the same meaning in different languages can produce different token counts. To find the exact count for a piece of text, you need the tokeniser used by that model.


Pre-trained Knowledge


Token prediction explains how a model produces text, but it does not yet explain why a model can answer questions without being given any external files. The answer lies in what it learnt during training. During training, a large language model learns patterns and information from massive amounts of text, code, and other data.


This is also why, even if we do not provide the model with any external files, it can still answer a large number of questions about common sense, history, maths, programming, and so on. This content is not obtained by the model through temporary searching. The model has already learnt patterns related to this information during training. This information is often described as the model’s

pre-trained knowledge

.


However, the model does not have a perfect database of facts. It learns patterns from its training data, and these patterns can sometimes be incomplete, outdated,

biased

, or simply wrong. When the model does not have enough reliable information to answer a question, it may still try to produce an answer based on what it has learnt. This is one reason

hallucinations

 can happen.


Multimodality


Pre-trained knowledge is still mainly about patterns learnt from text and other training data …

author: CNT Valladolid
title: SENIOR exprime a las que te cuidan
content:
Trabajadoras con derechos, cuidados de calidad


Hoy estamos aquí para decir basta a la precariedad. Las trabajadoras de Ayuda a Domicilio desempeñamos una labor imprescindible, aunque invisibilizada. Cada día entramos en los hogares de personas que necesitan apoyo para poder continuar con su vida cotidiana, acompañamos a personas mayores y dependientes, ayudamos en tareas básicas y hacemos frente a situaciones que requieren responsabilidad, paciencia, formación y, muchas veces, esfuerzo físico y emocional.


Sin embargo, quienes sostenemos este servicio soportamos unas condiciones laborales que no reconocen el valor y la responsabilidad de nuestro trabajo. La precariedad, la incertidumbre y la falta de respeto a nuestros derechos forman parte de nuestra realidad cotidiana.


Un caso que no podemos dejar pasar: Senior


Una compañera de CNT, trabajadora del Servicio de Ayuda a Domicilio del Ayuntamiento, se encuentra en una situación especialmente grave: cada mes recibe un salario diferente, sin estabilidad que le permita organizar su vida. Su salario no corresponde a lo establecido en el convenio.


A esto se suma que no le facilitan sus nóminas, ni su contrato de trabajo. La trabajadora se encuentra en una situación de absoluta incertidumbre e indefesión en sus derechos.


Hemos reclamado repetidamente a la empresa información y documentación que debería recibir de manera regular y la respuesta es silencio.


No podemos normalizar que el convenio sea papel mojado. Cuando el salario cambia constantemente y desconoces con qué cantidad vas a contar a final de mes, la precariedad no se queda en el trabajo, entra en nuestra casa y condiciona nuestra vida. Impidiéndonos que nos organicemos, generando una inseguridad que no podemos soportar.


Y mientras tanto, se nos pide responsabilidad, estar disponibles, ser pacientes y cuidadosas con las personas que atendemos.


¿Quién cuida a las que cuidamos?


La Ayuda a Domicilio es un servicio público y esencial. Para que pueda prestarse con calidad es necesario cuidar a quienes lo hacen posible. Una atención digna requiere trabajadoras con derechos, condiciones laborales estables y salarios dignos.


El problema no es solo de nuestra compañera, su situación es una realidad que afecta a todas las trabajadoras del sector: salarios insuficientes, jornadas y horarios difíciles de conciliar, sobrecarga de trabajo, exigencias que van más allá de nuestras funciones, y desconocimiento o incumplimiento de los derechos que nos corresponden.


Asistimos a hogares donde la enfermedad, la dependencia, la soledad, el deterioro físico o cognitivo y situaciones familiares complejas es el pan de cada día. Un trabajo que nos exige esfuerzo físico y emocional.


Organizarnos para defendernos


La respuesta no puede ser que cada trabajadora tenga que enfrentarse sola a su empresa. Cuando una trabajadora tiene un problema laboral, conocer sus derechos es importante; pero organizarse colectivamente es esencial.


Desde CNT Valladolid alentamos a las trabajadoras de Ayuda a Domicilio a organizarse, compartir sus problemas y defender juntas unas condiciones laborales dignas. Vamos todas a exigir unas condiciones laborales a la altura de la responsabilidad que asumimos, por nosotras y por las personas a las que atendemos Si trabajas en Ayuda a Domicilio y no se respeta tu salario, tu horario laboral, o si simplemente quieres organizarte con otras compañeras, acércate a CNT, infórmate y participa. La precariedad no se combate en soledad.

title: Devon And Somerset Staghounds Recreate The Horror Of The Barle Stag
content:
Thirty-two years on from the controversy of the Barle stag, the excuses may have changed, but for the hunted stag the suffering is horribly familiar.


More than three decades have passed since the death of the Barle stag became one of the most notorious episodes associated with stag hunting on Exmoor. Yet for those who witnessed what happened on Saturday 12th September 2026, the events along the River Barle carried disturbing echoes of the past – a past that, sadly, does not seem so very different from the present.


On Saturday, this magnificent stag was found quickly in the boggy woodland below Twitchen, and from there the pursuit began.


The stag was described as “a very fine up and coming stag” by a deer expert from Wildlife Guardian


A sab from North Dorset Hunt Saboteurs struggled to keep pace as the stag was chased across Molland Common and West Anstey Common. The stag crossed the road just moments before sabs arrived.


From there, the stag continued towards the River Barle at Mountsey Castle. It was there that sabs saw him bursting across a track in front of point riders and a quad bike before heading down and into the river.


By this stage the pursuit had clearly taken a terrible toll on the animal. Relays of hounds are typically deployed in pairs during stag hunting, allowing a pursuit to continue for hours. On this occasion the chase lasted around two hours before the stag was brought to bay.


Relays of pairs of hounds are used during the pursuit of the stag.


“At bay” is a hunting term to describe the point at which a hunted stag has stopped fleeing and turns to face his pursuers. It is often the culmination of an exhausting chase: an animal pushed to the point where escape is impossible, confronted by those pursuing him and facing what may come next.


The powerful wild animal who had crossed miles of difficult country was now struggling simply to continue. He was heaving for breath and, at one point appeared to be unable to even hold his head up properly. Instead of running, he was reduced to a slow walk.


And still the pursuit continued.


This is the image that cuts through the arguments used to defend stag hunting. Whatever terminology, smokescreen or justification is employed, it boils down to an exhausted, tormented animal desperately trying to keep moving.


The stag managed a final slow trot upstream before exhaustion overcomes him for the final time.


A sab entered the river after him, the Barle was shallow after a summer of drought. The river offered a moment of respite for the animal, he even managed a slow trot upstream, with the cooling water seeming to relieve him slightly, despite everything he had already endured.


A hound was also in the river, but appeared not to have picked up the scent. The sab continued to follow, the stones underfoot were slippery, making progress difficult while they also tried to protect their camera equipment and preserve the footage already recorded. The footage in stag hunting is important.


A small child was taking part in the obscene spectacle


Documenting is particularly important in stag hunting, because intervention at the final stages can be extraordinarily difficult.


During fox hunts, direct intervention by saboteurs can sometimes give a hunted animal the opportunity to escape. With an exhausted stag standing at bay, the situation is quite different.


On several occasions, sabs have managed to reach a stag standing at bay and position themselves close to the animal. Their presence may offer some protection for a limited period, but the stag is already frightened and exhausted.


Pressure continues and if the stag is frightened into moving again, even one final desperate burst can take him beyond the immediate protection of saboteurs.


If the stag cannot be saved, then at the very least what happens to him should not be hidden. People should be able to see what these animals endure and understand what the pursuit at the heart of this so-called “sport” actually looks like.


The hunts gunman, Shaun Kelloway, then dismounted from his horse, and carrying his gun, began following the stag on foot along the riverbank.


Gunman Shaun Kelloway dismounted, and carried his gun, before shooting the animal.


Sabs were hindered and obstructed by hunt supporters, while further ahead hounds could be heard being “hunted on”.


Yet despite everything – the woodland, the commons, the roads, the hills and finally the river, this extraordinary animal kept …

title: Lilia Folt - Riding the Waves of Repression
content:
Author

: Lilia Folt

Title

: Riding the Waves of Repression

Date

: August 30

th

, 2026

Notes

: Originally published in

Dissonant Times

, a grassroots journalism and counter-info project from the Willamette Valley of Oregon.

Author bio:

 Lilia Folt is a transsexual anarchist enamored with cycles of death and rebirth, creation and destruction, and convinced that strategic thinking requires limitless, amoral compassion. She’s excited to explore these ideas and more in her column, Anarchic Reflections.

Source

: Dissonant Times


“

Trust your instincts. To all people, and across all civilizations, you know what ‘normal’ is. You


know what ‘beautiful’ is. You know what ‘good’ is. You know that families are right. You know


that children are precious and beautiful and must be protected. You know that the criminal, and


the junkie, and the predator, is a threat to normal, healthy, living.


This is so much deeper than issues about taxation and regulation, though they’re incredibly


important. It’s about normal, healthy, ordered, living.

”

 — Stephen Miller


 These words, spoken by White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller at the Ministerial on the Resurgence of Political Terrorism, sum up the fascist project. Normal, healthy, ordered living. And to achieve this, the expulsion and extermination of everything deemed abnormal, unnatural, disorderly — in a word,

uncontrollable

.


 This Ministerial, called for by the US, brought officials from 66 countries together in Washington, DC on July 16

th

, 2026. At the Ministerial, Stephen Miller and secretary of state Marco Rubio declared that, amidst devastating and accelerating climate-destruction, compounding economic crises, and genocidal and imperialist wars, “left-wing terrorism” constitutes the gravest threat to civilization, and that rooting it out and fighting it must be prioritized accordingly by world leaders and the states they command. Rarely has the essential function of the state* been laid so bare. Defenders of the state claim that the state exists to provide for and protect its people. At many times in history, this claim has been given a tenuous truth due to the pittances it has given in the form of social programs. However, the past year and a half has shown what the state really is when push comes to shove: a means of sorting people into categories of included/excluded, productive to the economy/surplus to the economy, to provide conditional ‘safety’ and support for the former, and violence in forms both dramatic and insidiously minute for the latter. And, as the crises continue to pile on, more and more people are being sorted into the latter category.


 The Ministerial is merely the formalization of an ongoing global wave of repression of social movements on the part of the governments of this planet. Here in the United States, there is the Prairieland case, Spokane, the Minnesota 15

[1]

. Overseas, in the Philippines and Indonesia, there are high-profile cases wherein anarchists are being targeted explicitly for espousing an anti-state, anti-capitalist ideology. In Indonesia, dozens of anarchist comrades have been arrested, kept in terrible conditions, and charged with being part of the so-called “Chaos Star Network,” a completely fictional entity made up by the Indonesian state. Some are calling it a renewed “Red Scare”

[2]

. Comrades in the Philippines are calling it the “Black Scare,” to point out how much anarchism as an ideology is being singled out in the repression

[3]

. And of course, no matter what you call it, here in the United States the repressive wave against social movements is one in the same as the campaign of terror, violence against, and displacement of immigrants, further legislative attempts to eliminate transgender existence, a rollback of women’s rights in general, and an overall attempt to restrict any form of truly free expression and existence.


 Here in Eugene, there are the federal indictments that came down for alleged actions during the unrest in January following the ICE murders of Renee Good and Alex Pretti, numerous arrests and detainments by feds for protest activity at the Federal Building, and arrests at various street protests over the past year and a half that indicate a growing intolerance for disruptive protest³. There is a steady trickle of ICE detainments, sometimes leading to deportations, numbers of which have increased since earlier this year. Not to mention, the continued war …

title: DİSK’ten 18 Eylül Uluslararası Eşit Ücret Günü açıklaması: Eşdeğer işe eşit ücret yasal güvenceye alınmalı
content:
Devrimci İşçi Sendikaları Konfederasyonu (DİSK), 18 Eylül Uluslararası Eşit Ücret Günü kapsamında yaptığı açıklamada, Türkiye’de erkeklerin gelirlerinin kadınlardan yüzde 30 daha yüksek olduğunu vurguladı. Açıklamada, çalışma hayatındaki cinsiyet temelli gelir eşitsizliğinin son bulması ve "eşdeğer işe eşit ücret" ilkesinin yasal güvenceye kavuşturulması talep edildi.

DİSK'in açıklamasında, bakım emeğinin tek taraflı olarak kadınların üzerine yıkılması nedeniyle kadın işçilerin çifte mesai yaptığı ve buna rağmen erkeklerden daha düşük gelir elde ettiği belirtildi.

Açıklamada, Uluslararası Çalışma Örgütü (ILO) verilerine dikkat çekilerek küresel düzeyde kadınların ücretli istihdamda erkeklerden yüzde 20 daha az kazandığı, mevcut koşullarda bu uçurumun kapanmasının 257 yıl sürebileceği aktarıldı.

Türkiye'deki tablonun daha ağır seyrettiğine işaret edilen açıklamada, kadınlar 100 lira kazanırken erkeklerin ortalama 130 lira gelir elde ettiği kaydedildi. Bu gelir farkının ücretli çalışanlarda yüzde 19, yevmiyelilerde ise yüzde 89 düzeyine kadar çıktığı vurgulandı.

İş gücüne katılım oranlarındaki eşitsizliğe de değinilen açıklamada, Türkiye'de erkeklerin iş gücüne katılım oranının yüzde 70,6, kadınların ise yüzde 35,3 olduğu paylaşıldı. 5,5 milyon kadının ev işleri ve bakım sorumlulukları nedeniyle iş gücü piyasasına dahil olamadığı belirtilirken, 33,9 milyon kadından sadece 6,7 milyonunun kayıtlı ve tam zamanlı istihdamda yer aldığı, 27 milyon kadının ise kayıt dışı ya da yarı zamanlı işlere mahkum bırakıldığı ifade edildi.

İktidarın Orta Vadeli Program hedeflerinde yer alan esnek çalışma modellerine tepki gösterilen açıklamada, kadın istihdamını artırma gerekçesiyle sunulan esnek çalışmanın kadınları ucuz iş gücü haline getirdiği kaydedildi. Çözümün esnekleşmede değil, insanca yaşanabilecek ücret, sendikal haklar ve güvenceli istihdamda olduğu hatırlatılarak Türkiye'nin 1966'da imzaladığı ILO'nun 100 No'lu Eşit Ücret Sözleşmesi'nin gereklerinin yerine getirilmesi istendi.

DİSK, açıklamanın sonunda taleplerini sıraladı:

Eşdeğer işe eşit ücret politikası yasal güvence altına alınmalı ve iş yerlerinde etkin denetim mekanizmaları kurulmalıdır.

Yetki ve karar mekanizmalarında kadınların eşit temsiliyeti sağlanmalıdır.

Kadın istihdamında esnek çalışma dayatmasından vazgeçilmeli, tam zamanlı ve güvenceli iş olanakları yaratılmalıdır.

Bakım yükünü kadınların üzerinden almak için ücretsiz ve kamusal kreş, gündüz bakımevi ile hasta ve yaşlı bakım merkezleri yaygınlaştırılmalıdır.

İstanbul Sözleşmesi'nin feshinden vazgeçilmeli; 6284 sayılı Kanun etkin uygulanmalı ve ILO'nun 190 sayılı Şiddet ve Taciz Sözleşmesi derhal onaylanmalıdır

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Nêzîkî 1250 akademîsyenan bertek nîşanî operasyonên li dîjî LGBTÎ+yan dan
content:
Ji welatên cûda ên cîhanê akademîsyen û lêkolîneran, bi nameyeke vekirî ya hevpar desteserkirin û girtinên mafparêz û LGBTÎ+yan ên li Tirkiyeyê şermezar kirin.


Îmzeya nêzîkî 1250 kesan li bin nameyê ye. Di nav wan de keseyatên weke Judith Butler, Slavoj Žižek, Étienne Balibar, Noura Erakat, Neve Gordon, Eyal Weizman, Sherene Seikaly û Lisa Hajjar hene.


Îmzakaran di daxuyaniyê de diyar kirin û gotin: "Em desteserkirina bi komî ya mafparêz û LGBTÎ+yan a li Tirkiyeyê bi tundî şermezar dikin û bang dikin ku wan demildest serbest berdin."


“Êrişî azadiya rêxistinbûn û derbirînê kirine"


Di daxuyaniyê de hate bi bîrxistin ku komeleyên di operasyonan de hatine armancgirtin bi awayekî qanûnî hatine vekirin û hinek ji wan bêtirî 30 sal in xebatan dikin.


Îmzakaran weha gotin: "Dîtina xebatên wan weke sûc, êrişek e li dijî azadiya rêxistinbûn, derbirîn û akademîk."


Çar daxwaz


Akademîsyen û lêkolîneran bangî rayedarên Tirkiyeyê kirin û ev daxwaz anîn ziman:


"Em daxwaz dikin ku hemû kesên hatine desteserkirin demildest serbest bên berdan,  lêpirsîn bên rawestandin, amûrên ku dest danîne ser bên vegerandin û biryarên astengkirin bên rakirin."


Di daxuyaniyê de ji bo piştevaniyê bang li zanîngeh û saziyên akademîk jî hate kirin.


Metin bi van gotinan bi dawî bû: "Em li cem hevkarên xwe û tevgera LGBTÎ+yan ya li Tirkiyeyê ne."

title: Открыт предзаказ на книгу Петра Кропоткина «В русских и французских тюрьмах»
content:
Коллектив «Эгалите» отправил в печать переиздание книги «В русских и французских тюрьмах» Петра Кропоткина. Книга затрагивает тему политического использования тюрем авторитарными системами, а также критикует саму идею принудительной изоляции, как антигуманную и криминогенную. Книга повлияла на современную прогрессивную криминологию.

Этот проект «Эгалите» задумал в помощь организациям, поддерживающим политизаключенных. 50% средств с продаж будут каждый месяц направляться действующим инициативам.

«В русских и французских тюрьмах», как и все работы Петра Кропоткина, отличается глубиной анализа и жанровым репертуаром методов, используемых философом для понимания того, чем является тюремная система в современном мире. Это автоэтнография, сохраняющая для нас ценнейшие сведения о нанесенных политикой принудительного заключения культурных и ментальных травмах. Это книга политэкономических размышлений о структурной роли, которую сыграли тюрьмы в подавлении солидарных чувств между людьми посредством перемещения, изоляции, сокрытия, насилия и эксплуатации. Также это внимательное психосоциальное исследование способов реабилитации, восстановления доверия к миру и возвращения самоуважения пострадавшим от тюремного заключения. Наконец, это философски аргументированное обращение к широкому обществу отказаться от логики надзора и наказания.

Смелый труд Петра Алексеевича признается тюремными аболиционистами разных стран классическим текстом антикарцеральной традиции. «В русских и французских тюрьмах» является неотъемлемой частью канона анархистской криминологии и юридических исследований. О том, что делает книгу по-прежнему актуальной и какие интуиции Кропоткина были подтверждены современными криминологами, социологами и философами, в своем предисловии рассказал Джефф Шантц — доктор юридических наук, основатель и главный редактор журнала «Radical Criminology», составитель антологии «Classic Writings in Anarchist Criminology: A Historical Dismantling of Punishment» и теоретик анархо-синдикализма.

author: L214
title: Michel-Édouard Leclerc, président de l’élevage intensif
content:
Truies enfermées en cages la moitié de leur vie

Mutilation des porcelets (meulage des dents, coupe des queues)

Animaux enfermés, détenus à vie sur un sol en béton sans paille

Jeremstar interpelle Michel-Édouard Leclerc

L214 s’invite au Prix Landerneau des lecteurs fondé par Michel-Édouard Leclerc

Une barquette géante remise à Michel-Edouard Leclerc

Dans son dernier livre, Michel-Édouard Leclerc nous donne sa vision de l’économie. Sans un mot pour les animaux. Et si nous profitions de la sortie de son livre pour susciter un engagement ?

Commandez gratuitement un lot de marque-pages

Rendez-vous dans votre librairie ou centre commercial de proximité

Glissez un exemplaire du marque-page dans chaque livre écrit par Michel-Edouard Leclerc !

Toutes les décorations de fêtes ont été commandées ! Si vous souhaitez tout de même participer à cette action, téléchargez et imprimez des décorations militantes sur ce lien. Merci d’agir pour les animaux avec L214 !

Les champs suivis d’un astérisque (*) sont obligatoires. Les commandes ne sont possibles qu’en France métropolitaine.

Demandons à E.Leclerc de tourner le dos aux pires pratiques d’élevage en s’engageant sur les critères du Pig Minimum Standards.

Contre la souffrance des animaux, agissez à nos côtés avec un don.

Choisissez le montant de votre don

Le Pig Minimum Standards (PMS) est un référentiel comprenant 9 critères liés aux conditions d’élevage et d’abattage des cochons. Il est soutenu par plusieurs associations de défense des animaux en France et en Europe.

L214 a fait un pas vers E.Leclerc en demandant à la chaîne de supermarchés de s’engager sur un nombre limité de critères du Pig Minimum Standards, dont la faisabilité ne peut être contestée. Il s’agit de s’approvisionner, d’ici 2030, uniquement auprès d’élevages :

respectant la réglementation en vigueur (fin des mutilations systématiques, de la castration sans anesthésie des porcelets et enrichissement de l’environnement des cochons) ;

ne recourant plus aux cages pour les truies.

Ces critères constituent aujourd’hui le strict minimum pour réduire les souffrances des cochons dans les élevages intensifs. De nombreuses entreprises se sont déjà engagées, comme Pizza Cosy, Boulangerie Ange, Best Western, Marie Blachère, Big Fernand ou encore Columbus Café & Co.

Découvrez le Pig Minimum Standards en détail en cliquant ici.

Le cap des 100 000 barquettes retournées est franchi !

Prix Landerneau, notamment en mars 2026 avec la vidéo tournée par Vakita où je dis que j’ai pu parler avec MEL

Lancement de Tournons le Dos, notre campagne citoyenne pour mobiliser plus largement.

L214 publie une enquête sur 8 élevages intensifs de cochons en Bretagne fournissant les supermarchés E.Leclerc. L’association porte plainte pour mauvais traitements contre ces élevages auprès des procureurs des tribunaux judiciaires de Saint-Brieuc et de Saint-Malo.

Lire notre communiqué de presse Enquête sur 8 élevages des Côtes-d’Armor

Première enquête sur un élevage fournissant E.Leclerc (Malansac) et première action coordonnée

L214 publie une nouvelle vidéo tournée dans un élevage de cochons qui fournit les magasins E.Leclerc. L’enseigne suspend son approvisionnement auprès de cet élevage le temps de l'enquête, mais ne s’engage pas à tourner le dos aux pires pratiques de l’élevage intensif des cochons. Lire notre communiqué de presse Enquête sur l’élevage de Saint-Carreuc

Aidez-nous à porter la voix des animaux et à obtenir des avancées pour eux.

Choisissez le montant de votre don

Merci pour votre commande, elle a bien été prise en compte ! Vous recevrez prochainement votre kit pour agir auprès de Leclerc.

author: Unknown
title: Affaire du 8 décembre : le délibéré du procès en appel
content:
La condamnation est tombée. Jeudi 10 septembre 2026, la juge Isabelle Schoonwater a donné le délibéré de l'affaire du 8 décembre 2020. On l'attendait depuis plus de 3 mois, depuis que le procès en appel s'est terminé fin mai à Paris.


Ou plutôt depuis 2 ans et demi, depuis la condamnation en première instance des 7 personnes censées constituer cette association de malfaiteurs terroriste. Et même depuis 5 ans et demi, depuis que les potes avaient été arrêtés par des flics sur-armés agissant pour le parquet anti-terroriste, et séquestrés dans les caves sordides de la

DGSI

 à Levallois-Perret. Pour rappel, lors des plaidoiries de 2026, les avocat·e·s avaient plaidé la relaxe générale pour l'accusation d'association de malfaiteurs terroriste (

AMT

) et une re-qualification des faits pour chacun.es.


La juge en a décidé autrement puisqu'elle maintient l'

AMT

. Comme en première instance elle le justifie par le fait que cette

AMT

 n'a pas besoin d'être constituée en groupe, ni d'avoir un but ou un projet mais qu'il suffit d'une “potentialité suffisante”. Pour cela elle se repose principalement sur la fabrication d'explosifs et d'une “convergence manifeste se caractérisant par une rupture avec la société” des accusé·e·s. Eh oui, vous avez bien lu, cette condamnation est bien celle d'un groupe qui n'en est pas un, pour avoir donné l'impression d'avoir un projet, indéterminé, de peut-être s'en prendre aux forces de l'ordre. Condamné·e·s pour des suspicions d'intention et un esprit rebelle

 

! 


Les peines (et les petites joies)


Pour Libre Flot, le soi-disant chef de la soi-disant bande, leur cible favorite, la condamnation est lourde : 5 ans de prison dont 3 ans de sursis probatoire pendant 2 ans, quasiment comme en première instance. Il ne lui reste que 2 mois qu'il n'a pas déjà fait en détention provisoire et qui pourront être aménagés (en bracelet électronique par exemple). Mais aussi un suivi socio-judiciaire pendant 5 ans avec une peine d'un an s'il n'obéit pas à ce suivi, ce qui représente une équipe pluri-disciplinaire sur son dos tout ce temps, “destinée à prévenir la récidive”. Également pour F, comme en première instance, l'inscription au

FIJAIT

, le fichier des auteurs d'infraction terroriste, qui court sur 20 ans avec des obligations (pointage, signaler les déplacements...) pendant 10 ans. 


Pour les autres, le

FIJAIT

 est retiré. C'est la perspective de retrouver petit-à-petit de la liberté de déplacement, en particulier pour les déménagements et les voyages à l'étranger, la fin des pointages trimestriels. Chacun·e subit encore un certain nombre d'obligations (de soin, de travail ou de formation) et d'interdictions (de port d'arme, de travailler dans certains domaines). Mais n'étant pas associées à un dispositif de marquage des ennemis intérieurs de l'État, les conséquences liées à ce fichage ne pourront au moins pas être étendues, et des demandes pourront être faites pour assouplir les contraintes du quotidien. 


Autre élément nouveau depuis le début de la procédure, les interdictions de communiquer entre elleux sont enfin tombées

 

! C'est une petite victoire après toutes ces années d'éloignement forcé.


Élément qui pourrait être risible qui a été ajouté à leur peine et qui n'existait pas en première instance, une inéligibilité pour une durée de 5 ans, au cas où l'un·e d'elleux voudrait se lancer en politique

 

;) Cela démontre néanmoins la crainte qu'iels utilisent des moyens politiques officiels.


Dans le classement de cette juge, vient ensuite S, dont la peine est un peu allégée par rapport à la première instance. 3 ans et demi dont 32 mois de sursis probatoire : il reste donc les 10 mois de ferme, qu'il a déjà purgé en préventive. En ce qui concerne C, W et B, iels sont condamné·e·s à 3 ans de prison dont 2 de sursis probatoire pendant 2 ans. On s'éloigne très peu des condamnations de la première instance, sauf pour B qui n'avait pas de ferme et qui n'avait pas fait de préventive. Les mois restants pourront être aménagés, par exemple en bracelet électronique, selon la volonté du ou de la juge d'application des peines anti-terroristes (

JAPAT

). On attend ce rendez-vous pour connaitre le détail des conditions de vie des 5 “associé.es” ces prochains mois. 


Pour l'un d'entre elleux l'

AMT

 tombe puisque la juge a prononcé la relaxe de M

 

! “Au bénéfice du doute”. C'est le seul qui n'a pas participé à la confection d'explosifs. La juge l'a bien interrogé sur les …

author: infolibre
title: Ο φασισμός εργαλείο του καπιταλισμού. Το αντιφασιστικό κίνημα μαχητικό, στη κοινωνία και τους δρόμους.
content:
Η αναγκαιότητα ενός αντιφασιστικού κινήματος, με κοινωνικοποίηση του μαχητικού αντιφασισμού, συσπείρωση και δράση κοινωνικών και ταξικών δυνάμεων βάσης, καθώς και ενότητα των διαφορετικών πλευρών αντίστασης, διατυπώθηκε στην εκδήλωση που πραγματοποιήθηκε στο infolibre με αφορμή την 13η επέτειο από τη δολοφονία του Παύλου Φύσσα. Κι αυτά πέρα από τα «δημοκρατικά τόξα» ρεφορμιστικών και συστημικών δυνάμεων. Αλλά με αντιμετώπιση σε κοινωνία και τους δρόμους των νεοναζιστικών μορφωμάτων και ιδιαίτερη πάλη ενάντια στο ακροδεξιό ρεύμα κάθε μορφής που καταγράφεται σε άνοδο σε πολλές χώρες ανά τον κόσμο.


Το θέμα της εκδήλωσης ήταν:

Όψεις του φασισμού και τους προβληματισμούς για το παρόν

.


Ομιλητές οι:


Κώστας Παπαδάκης

, δικηγόρος, Πολιτική Αγωγή στη δίκη της Χρυσής Αυγής.


Νίκος Νικολαΐδης

, από τις Σημειώσεις της Στέπας.


Γιώργος Σμυρλής

, από τη Νεολαία Κομμουνιστική Απελευθέρωση (ΝΚΑ).


Συντονισμός-εισήγηση από το

infolibre

.


Αναλύθηκε και συζητήθηκε η σημερινή κατάσταση και το πώς ερμηνεύουμε τη σημερινή έξαρση του φασισμού, αλλά  και τι μπορούμε να κάνουμε για να την αντιμετωπίσουμε.


Όπως διατυπώθηκε:

Ο φασισμός είναι ανέκαθεν το μακρύ χέρι του καπιταλισμού, με το αστικό σύστημα να χρησιμοποιεί αυτές τις δυνάμεις όποτε έχει συμφέρον

. Επίσης τονίστηκε ότι:

Ο φασισμός συνδέεται με τον φιλελευθερισμό και λειτουργεί ως προληπτική αντεπανάσταση.


Στα σημερινά, θα πρέπει να κινηθούμε

ενάντια σε κάθε σχέδιο πολιτικής νομιμοποίησης

 του Κασιδιάρη, που στηρίζει το σύστημα, και κάθε φασιστικού μορφώματος.


Να συνεχίσουμε τον αντιφασισμό σε κοινωνία και δρόμους. Με οργάνωση από τα κάτω και κοινότητες αγώνα.


ΑΝΑΛΥΤΙΚΟΤΕΡΗ ΠΑΡΟΥΣΙΑΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΕΙΣΗΓΗΣΕΩΝ – ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΕΩΝ


Συντονισμός – εισήγηση

infolibre

:


Στην αρχή έγινε ιστορική αναφορά στη προ 13ετίας δολοφονία του Παύλου Φύσσα από τους χρυσαυγίτες, επισημαίνοντας ότι αυτός είχε αντιληφθεί ποια είναι η κοινωνική λειτουργία του φασισμού. Ως άνθρωπος με ταξική συνείδηση και γόνιμη σκέψη, τάχθηκε απέναντι στον φασισμό και τον ντόπιο φορέα του, τη Χρυσή Αυγή, σε μια εποχή που αυτή σάρωνε στις εργατικές περιοχές του Πειραιά και της Αθήνας, ενώ την ίδια στιγμή προωθούνταν από το κεφάλαιο και τα συστημικά μέσα ενημέρωσης. Η δολοφονία έγινε σε μια εργατική περιοχή την οποία η Χρυσή Αυγή, σε συνεργασία με το κομπραδόρικο επιχειρηματικό/εφοπλιστικό κεφάλαιο, προσπάθησε να ελέγξει, χτυπώντας απεργίες και στοχοποιώντας συνδικαλιστές.


Ως τραγική ειρωνεία, λίγες μέρες πριν από τη συμπλήρωση 13 χρόνων από τη δολοφονία Φύσσα, αποφυλακίζεται ένας από τους βασικούς ιθύνοντες της τότε Χρυσής Αυγής και μέλος του πολιτικού της συμβουλίου, ο Ηλίας Κασιδιάρης, ο οποίος δείχνει να είναι ο κύριος πόλος συσπείρωσης των φασιστοειδών. Είχε καταδικαστεί μετά την πολύκροτη δίκη της Χρυσής Αυγής, στις 07/10/2020, για διεύθυνση εγκληματικής οργάνωσης μαζί με άλλους χρυσαυγίτες. Μια καταδίκη η οποία ήταν περισσότερο αποτέλεσμα της κοινωνικής πίεσης και της λαϊκής βούλησης, παρά διάθεσης των επίσημων θεσμών, οι οποίοι σε κάθε περίπτωση επιδίωξαν να επωφεληθούν από τη φασιστική λαίλαπα.


Όλα αυτά συμβαίνουν την ίδια στιγμή που οι επιθέσεις φασιστοειδών σε μετανάστες και άτομα της ΛΟΑΤΚΙ+ κοινότητας συνεχίζονται, με ενδεικτικά περιστατικά επιθέσεων, μόνο για την πόλη της Θεσσαλονίκης, να αποτελούν η επίθεση όχλου νεαρών σε τρανς άτομα στην πλατεία Αριστοτέλους τον Μάρτιο του 2024, η επίθεση σε ανήλικους πρόσφυγες της δομής φιλοξενίας Ωραιοκάστρου, καθώς και η δράση της φασιστικής παραφυάδας ΕΝΕΘ (Εθνικιστική Νεολαία Θεσσαλονίκης).


Σε παγκόσμιο επίπεδο, η άνοδος της ακροδεξιάς είναι ξεκάθαρη και τείνει να γίνει οικουμενική. Από τον Τραμπ στις ΗΠΑ και τη Μελόνι στην Ιταλία, μέχρι τα πρόσφατα αποτελέσματα στις περιφερειακές εκλογές στη Γερμανία, βλέπουμε τον παγκόσμιο χάρτη να αναδιαμορφώνεται με ευνοϊκούς όρους για την ακροδεξιά, η οποία δεν είναι τίποτε άλλο από έναν «εξευγενισμένο» και πολιτικά ορθό (politically correct) φασισμό.


To AfD, που επικράτησε στις πρόσφατες περιφερειακές εκλογές στη Γερμανία, το 2013 είχε συσταθεί ως ένα συντηρητικό-πατριωτικό κόμμα που προσέφερε πολιτικό χώρο στον εθνικισμό, υποστηρίζοντας ότι δεν είχε σχέση με τον εξτρεμισμό της άκρας δεξιάς, όπως το NPD (Εθνικό Δημοκρατικό Κόμμα Γερμανίας). Παρόλα αυτά, όπως αποδείχθηκε, όλα αυτά ήταν επικοινωνιακά παιχνίδια για να καλυφθεί το φασιστικό προσωπείο του κόμματος. Αυτή η τακτική είναι γνωστή στην Ευρώπη εδώ και πάνω από 30 χρόνια, ενώ τείνει να αναβιώσει και στην Ελλάδα μέσα στη σημερινή συνθήκη …
