author: Dyepeson Martins
title: Ministra Cármen Lúcia dá o tom do dia no STF: “não garantimos o rigor que deveríamos”
content:
A sessão histórica do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), marcada para analisar as mensagens trocadas entre o ministro Alexandre de Moraes e o ex-banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, dono do Master, estava marcada para começar às 10h. Já passava das 16h20 desta terça-feira, 15 de setembro, e a reunião ainda não tinha alcançado a discussão do mérito da pauta – nenhum dos nove integrantes da mais alta Corte do país havia se manifestado sobre a a—bertura de uma investigação sobre a conduta de Moraes, exposta por outro magistrado do grupo, ministro André Mendonça. O debate, naquele momento, envolvia uma Questão de Ordem apresentada pelo decano Gilmar Mendes, que tentou suspender a reunião extraordinária e marcá-la para o próximo dia 23.


Duas horas depois, a sessão foi finalizada, e o mérito continuou sem análise. Ao longo de todo o dia, os ministros deliberaram apenas se Moraes deveria ter seu julgamento conjunto com o de Mendonça. No turbilhão da crise que assolou o Supremo desde o dia 2 de setembro, Moraes havia pedido ao presidente do Corte, Edson Fachin, a inclusão de Mendonça no inquérito das Fake News. A decisão foi baseada em relatórios de inteligência fornecidos pela Polícia Federal (PF), em que a corporação aponta um desequilíbrio na condução de André Mendonça no caso Master contra políticos, com indícios de “enviesamento”.


Alexandre de Moraes conta com aliados como Gilmar Mendes e Flávio Dino para evitar uma investigação sobre sua suposta relação com o caso Master


Prevaleceu no plenário, por quatro votos a três, a recusa à Questão de Ordem apresentada por Gilmar, de unir os dois casos. Foram favoráveis os ministros Gilmar Mendes, Alexandre de Moraes, Cristiano Zanin e Flávio Dino. Enquanto Fachin, André Mendonça e Luiz Fux e Cármen Lúcia foram contrários à união das duas análises. Houve, porém, o pedido de vista do ministro Flávio Dino. Isso significa que a sessão será interrompida por até 90 dias para que ele possa analisar melhor o caso e posteriormente devolver aos magistrados.


Única mulher a integrar a Corte, Cármen Lúcia só tomou a palavra às 17h56, após mais de sete horas do início do julgamento, em que permaneceu em silêncio, diferentemente de seus pares do gênero masculino. Em sua fala, ela declarou estar “profundamente consternada e triste” com a crise institucional do STF. Apontou, ainda, que a Corte provocou “intranquilidade” no país, que está a menos de 20 dias do primeiro turno das eleições presidenciais. Em seguida, pediu “desculpa” ao “povo brasileiro”. “Eu peço desculpa ao povo brasileiro por talvez ter esperado de mim uma postura diferente. Mas acho que todos nós aqui queríamos a mesma coisa, que era tentar resolver, e as questões não foram resolvidas e foram crescendo demais”, afirmou.


A ministra ainda criticou o que chamou de “espetacularização” dos julgamentos do STF. “Nós não garantimos o rigor e seriedade que deveríamos. Peço desculpas aos colegas e ao povo por não ter conseguido resolver essas questões de melhor modo. Houve uma espetacularização desses casos, dessa sessão, que não faz mal apenas ao Supremo, mas ao país. O país espera uma tranquilidade do Supremo que não conseguimos dar.”


A declaração da ministra ocorreu após uma série de embates entre os ministros durante a reunião desta terça-feira. O primeiro deles foi protagonizado pelo ministro Flávio Dino e o próprio presidente da Corte, Edson Fachin, que abriu a sessão centralizando em seu discurso a necessidade de preservar “sensatez, decoro e serenidade”. Ainda na primeira hora, porém, o equilíbrio entre os magistrados pareceu se desfazer. Dino pediu um aparte a Toffoli, que também esteve no epicentro do inquérito do Master, mas teve seu caso arquivado após uma reunião a portas fechadas entre os ministros.


Interrompendo Dino, Fachin respondeu que a palavra deveria ser sempre solicitada à presidência. Último ministro a compor a Corte, Dino retrucou que seguiria o regimento interno do Supremo, que, segundo ele, tem o aparte “dirigido ao relator”. A troca de farpas continuou, com direito a citação por Dino dos filósofos Thomas Hobbes e Aristóteles, além do cantor e compositor Chico César.


Antes mesmo do início da sessão, o ministro encaminhou um requerimento ao decano Gilmar Mendes, para que ele, na sua condição de substituto legal do Presidente e do Vice-presidente da Corte, restabelecesse o cumprimento da Constituição Federal, da lei e do Regimento Interno do STF. author: anred
title: Acuerdo para designación de jueces: como era previsto, fue una semana de fallos para el poder
content:
Luego del escandaloso acuerdo entre el oficialismo, el peronismo y el pro para el acuerdo de pliegos y designación de jueces paso lo esperado. En apenas unos días, una serie de decisiones judiciales beneficiaron a Mauricio Macri, Javier Milei, Luis Caputo y funcionarios de la gestión macrista. Las resoluciones se conocieron al mismo tiempo que se consolida la nueva composición de la Cámara Federal porteña, integrada entre otros por Pablo Bertuzzi y Pablo Yadarola, recientemente designados por el Gobierno. Por ANRed


El 3 de septiembre, el juez Marcelo Martínez de Giorgi sobreseyó a Gustavo Arribas, Silvia Majdalani y otros exfuncionarios de la AFI en la causa por las tareas de inteligencia realizadas durante las cumbres de la OMC de 2017 y el G20 de 2018. El CELS cuestionó la decisión y anunció que apelará.


El 7 de septiembre, la Sala I de la Cámara Federal confirmó el sobreseimiento de

Mauricio Macri, Arribas y Majdalani

 en otra investigación por la presunta recolección ilegal de correos electrónicos de dirigentes políticos, periodistas y miembros de fuerzas de seguridad.


Ese mismo tribunal confirmó el sobreseimiento de

Luis Caputo

 en una causa iniciada en 2017, vinculada con su actuación durante el gobierno de Macri y la supuesta omisión de información patrimonial y posibles incompatibilidades relacionadas con operaciones financieras.


También fue archivada la investigación por el préstamo de

US$57.000 millones del FMI solicitado durante el gobierno de Macri

. Los camaristas Mariano Llorens y Pablo Bertuzzi consideraron que se trató de una decisión política que no configuraba un delito probado. La Procuración del Tesoro, ya bajo el gobierno de Milei, había desistido de continuar como querellante.


En el caso de

Javier Milei

, la Justicia todavía no cerró la causa $LIBRA, pero la nueva Cámara Federal confirmó que cinco inversores que denunciaron haber sido perjudicados no podrán actuar como querellantes. La investigación continúa, aunque queda sin esas querellas particulares. Días después, el juez Martínez de Giorgi también rechazó que dos diputados de la Coalición Cívica se incorporaran como querellantes.


Y este martes se sumó otro sobreseimiento:

Flavio, Hugo y Rosana Caputo

, hermanos del ministro de Economía, fueron desvinculados de la causa que investigaba el presunto financiamiento de Revolución Federal mediante contrataciones de Caputo Hermanos. La Justicia sostuvo que no pudo acreditarse una finalidad delictiva en esas operaciones. Los integrantes de Revolución Federal, en cambio, fueron enviados a juicio por amenazas e incitación a la violencia colectiva.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida de Agencia de Noticias Red Acción (@anredaccion)


EL ACUERDO QUE PRECEDIÓ A LOS FALLOS


Los nuevos fallos tienen como antecedente inmediato la votación del Senado del 28 de agosto. Con los votos del oficialismo, el PRO, la UCR y el peronismo, fueron aprobados

66 de 67 pliegos judiciales

.


Entre ellos estuvo

Pablo Yadarola

, uno de los jueces que participó en el viaje a Lago Escondido de 2022 junto a magistrados, fiscales, funcionarios y empresarios. La designación había sido cuestionada anteriormente por sectores del kirchnerismo, que habían vinculado aquel viaje con una trama de relaciones entre miembros del Poder Judicial y sectores del poder económico.


La votación fue cuestionada por

Myriam Bregman

, quien señaló que en el Senado sectores que se presentan como opositores terminaron votando junto con el oficialismo y el macrismo los mismos jueces que anteriormente habían cuestionado.


“

Se hacen los opositores, pero votan juntos

”, sostuvo Bregman, y cuestionó que se aprobara a jueces vinculados al episodio de Lago Escondido.


La secuencia deja una postal política que merece ser mirada en conjunto:

designación de nuevos magistrados, acuerdos entre bloques para aprobar sus pliegos y, pocos días después, una batería de resoluciones que beneficia a figuras centrales del macrismo y del actual gobierno

.

author: Sara Connors
title: Couple on quest to learn more about 19th century bentwood box
content:
As soon as Tlingit artist Joanne Williams laid eyes on the bentwood box she and husband Maurice would eventually travel over 4,800 kilometres round trip to retrieve, she knew it was meant to be.


“As soon as I saw it, I had to take a big breath and realise that I’m going to go get this box no matter what it takes us,” she told

APTN News.


The pair recently acquired a bentwood box from a private seller in Washington state that they believe dates back to the 19th century and whose design suggests it may be of Tlingit origin.


Typically made from a single sheet of bent cedar, bentwood boxes were historically used for both practical and ceremonial purposes. They stored everything from food to regalia to canoe tackle and also served as important items in burials and funerals.


The Williamses, who are

bentwood box knowledge-holders and teachers

 based in Atlin, British Columbia, said the box is a remarkable find as those dating back to the 19

th

 century or earlier are generally only found in museums.


“It’s a fluke of luck,” Williams said. “This is a gift from the ancestors. It’s the only way it could be found.”


Williams said the seller, who lives near Blaine, Washington, inherited the box from his grandmother, a private collector who lived in Ketchikan, Alaska.


According to her, around 300 people were interested in buying the box, with offers reaching as high as $60,000 USD.


Williams said her work with bentwood boxes helped her stand out from the other buyers, and that the seller ultimately chose her as it was his grandmother’s wish to reunite cultural items in her collection with their rightful communities.


“As soon as the seller got a hold of me and told me that he made his mind up that only I would be getting it, I was sure that my ancestors were guiding me and making this happen for us,” she said.


The Williamses purchased the box with their own funds for $10,000 USD.


The box features U-shaped ovoids, or formline design. Photo: Submitted


The pair travelled from their home in Atlin to Washington state earlier this summer, braving intense wildfires to retrieve the sacred item. Williams said the trip was further complicated by

new U.S. rules on shipping art across the border

 and a days-long delay by her bank in releasing the funds needed for the purchase.


But she said the journey was well worth it when she first saw the item.


“I had tears in my eyes. I was overwhelmed with the feeling that my ancestors were right near me,” she said.


Williams acknowledged she’s received some criticism for buying the item from a seller, but argued it’s sometimes necessary to ensure cultural items return to their rightful communities.


“That’s one of the biggest things that people were complaining about,” she said. “(But) if I didn’t do it, I wouldn’t have it in my hands right now. I would have missed out.”


The purchase is reminiscent of another sacred item involving Williams’ First Nation, the Taku River Tlingit.


The band paid an auction house around $40,000 in 2022 for a

19

th

 century Chilkat robe

, which has since been

returned to the community

.


Not much known about box—at least not yet


Williams said formline imagery on the box indicates it might, in fact, originate from her own First Nation. She said she is not sharing what those images are for the time being because many people have contacted her claiming the box comes from their community.


The Williams’ are safekeeping the box at Museum of Anthropology at the University of British Columbia (UBC) while non-invasive work is conducted to find out more about its origins.


That work will include analysing the paint used and also inviting other bentwood box makers to examine it.


Sue Rowley, the museum’s director, agrees that the box has characteristics of Tlingit design.


She said clues suggesting its origin include the ovoids it features—elongated circles with flattened bottoms typical of Tlingit formline design. She also noted the box appears to be painted with both burnt, ground-up bone and red ochre, and that operculum, or sea snail shells, were used on the lid—materials commonly found in Tlingit communities.


“What a stunning example this is of incredible craftsmanship, artwork, art history, and cultural significance of bentwood boxes on the Northwest Coast, and looking (very much like) bentwood boxes of the 19th century,” she said.


Maurice said the advanced craftsmanship required to make the box makes it even more remarkable …

author: Susan Price
title: ‘We can all have a good life and live within planetary boundaries’
content:
See Yong Feng was one of the guest speakers at the Ecosocialism 2026 conference in Magan-djin/Brisbane on September 11–13. He explained in his presentation, “Degrowth and Ecosocialism”, how it would be possible for all people — in the Global South and Global North — to have a good life without crossing planetary boundaries.

See previously worked as an architect and returned to Singapore last year after completing a Masters in political ecology, environmental justice and degrowth at the Autonomous University of Barcelona. He currently works in book publishing and organises with Singapore Climate Rally as well as the independent media network NIMBUS.

During the conference, See spoke with Green Left’s Peter Boyle about degrowth and how humanity can live within planetary boundaries.

You studied under Professor Jason Hickel at the Autonomous University of Barcelona. He has been at the cutting edge of debates and discussions around ecosocialism and degrowth. What do you think are the most important areas of research that Hickel and his team have covered in the past couple of years?

Research has been done to quantify and prove to conventional economists — and other people who need to see the facts — the extent of the extraction and exploitation that’s going on.

A lot of the recent work on unequal exchange has calculated what is the amount of embodied labour, land, energy and material resources that Global North countries get from the Global South — essentially through cheaper prices. It shows how imperialism works within the global trading system that’s supposedly based on “fair” prices. This is in addition to the very visible imperialism: invading countries and other military interventions.

Their research makes a very strong point that ecosocialism needs to be anti-imperial and decolonial.

What this means in material terms is to stop extracting from the Global South to allow it the freedom to develop on its own terms; [for Global South peoples] to have the sovereignty to decide how they want to develop.

One powerful quantification you shared at the Ecosocialism 2026 conference was what it would cost, in terms of resources, to give everybody on Earth a good life. Is that relatively recent research? How important could it be for taking this issue to a broader audience?

It’s not just Hickel but also other researchers. One of the earlier ones was done by Professor Julia Steinberger [from Lausanne University], calculating what it would take to deliver a decent standard of living for all.

Hickel’s paper built on this and other research to show what this would cost in terms of energy and material use and show how viable it is to achieve all these things, as compared to the capitalist argument that only continued economic growth can end global poverty.

It found that we could reduce global energy and material use to less than a third of what we use today and achieve decent living standards for all, even accounting for an increase in the global population to 8.5 billion by 2050.

I think this is important, because two of the main arguments against degrowth are that it is not possible or that you’re asking people to give up too much to achieve this.

It also shows, of course, that people cannot continue living as some people do in many rich countries, like flying across the world every month. That kind of excessive consumption still needs to be curtailed. But it does show it is possible to have a good standard of living, as long as we are able to redistribute wealth, energy and materials fairly and equitably.

Implicit in this is a challenge to the way capitalist economics sees the world. As other speakers at the conference said, it is economics through the eyes of a plunderer; stuff to be taken from nature and taken from other human beings. How do you see the challenge of reframing economics around human need, collective control and living with nature?

It’s definitely not an easy transition — that’s where ecosocialism and the long tradition of organising comes in. What ecosocialism adds is that, in addition to fighting for workers’ rights and democratic control over production and consumption, there also needs to be consideration of what impact it has on the natural world and recognising ecological limits as part of the material conditions we live in.

I think more and more people are becoming aware of this.

There’s an article Hickel wrote called “The Double Objective of Democratic Ecosocialism”, which sums up the …

content:
Fotoğraf: Артур Стабулниекс/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 3.0

Serie A ekibi Bologna, geçen sezon Fenerbahçe'yi çalıştıran teknik direktör Domenico Tedesco'yla yollarını ayırdı.

Hem Almanya hem İtalya vatandaşı olan Tedesco yönetiminde 4 maçta 1 puan toplayabilen Bologna, Raffaele Palladino ile anlaştı. 42 yaşındaki Palladino daha önce Monza, Fiorentina ve geçen sezon da Atalanta'yı çalıştırdı.

Domenico Tedesco, 2025/26 sezonunda Fenerbahçe ile Süper Kupa kazanmış, ligi de Galatasaray'ın ardından ikinci tamamlamıştı. Alman teknik direktör, görevine son verilmesinin ardından çok sarı-lacivertli taraftar tarafından tesislerden uğurlanmıştı.

author: Darío Aranda
title: Hacia la masificación de agroecología: 3.000 hectáreas de arroz agroecológico
content:
Por Nahuel Lag


Traducción: Paula Veliz


La Cooperativa de Trabajadores Asentados de la Región de Porto Alegre (Cootap) lleva adelante desde Brasil una de las mayores producciones de arroz agroecológico de América Latina: 14.000 toneladas anuales en 3.000 hectáreas. La Cootap, que reúne a 600 familias nucleadas en el

Movimiento Sin Tierra (MST)

, trabaja además otras 2.000 hectáreas con producción diversificada de hortalizas, frutas, ganado para la producción lechera y piscicultura. “Somos generaciones de familias que lucharon por la tierra”, reivindica Nelson Krupinski, presidente de la Cootap.


La cooperativa no solo produce materia prima sino que agrega valor y tiene su propia marca,

Terra Livre Agroecológica

, para comercializar mermeladas, jugos y salsas de tomate, jugo de naranja, cerveza de arroz y la estrella de la cooperativa: el arroz blanco e integral. Como parte del MST, la Cootap avanza en un proceso que el movimiento campesino brasileño define como la “masificación de la agroecología”, cuenta con biofábrica, produce semillas y comenzó a tecnificar las tareas, incluyendo, la implementación de drones para aplicar los biopreparados sobre los cultivos.


La marca consolida “la convicción de que es posible producir alimentos más saludables y con mayor justicia social, valorando y preservando tanto a las personas como a los recursos naturales”. La agroecología no está solo en la ausencia del uso de agrotóxicos en la producción sino en el resto de sus dimensiones: sociales, culturales y éticas. “Trabajar la tierra, resistir por la vida”, sostienen.


Foto:  Cootap - MST Tierra Livre


Luchar por la tierra para alimentar


La historia de la Cootap es parte de la lucha por la reforma agraria en Brasil. Krupinski recuerda desde la

Guerra del Contestado

 —protagonizada por productores yerbateros y madereros del sur de Brasil entre 1912 y 1916 frente al Estado brasileño y la empresa de ferrocarriles estadounidense que los expulsó de sus tierras—, a la formación del Movimiento Sin Tierra y la consolidación de la organización a fines de la dictadura (década del 80), junto con otras fuerzas como la Comisión Pastoral de la Tierra (CPT), la Central Única de los Trabajadores (CUT) y el Partido de los Trabajadores (PT).


“Soy hijo de un pequeño agricultor. Mi padre luchó por la tierra en la década de 1990. Yo me sumé a esa lucha en el año 1999. La Cootap la integran familias asentadas entre 1992 y 2008. Dos, cuatro, seis años de campamento y ocupación del latifundio, de marchas, de presión al gobierno para conseguir la tierra”, pone en palabras una lucha que lleva años de poner el cuerpo.


Los asentamientos son la estrategia con la que los campesinos y campesinas sin tierra de Brasil hacen cumplir la “función social de la tierra”, un principio redactado en la Constitución brasileña de 1988. Bajo ese principio, la propiedad privada de la tierra no es un derecho absoluto sino que debe servir al bien común, priorizando su uso productivo y responsable por encima del mero lucro. El Instituto Nacional de Colonización y Reforma Agraria (Incra)


es el organismo que institucionalizó esa norma y está a cargo de comprar las tierras improductivas o degradadas para cederlas en concesión con destino a producción.


Las familias asentadas no son propietarias, pero tienen tierra pública para producir alimentos. Para continuar en esas tierras siempre

debe cumplirse con la función social: producir alimentos y preservar el ambiente

 sino el Estado puede reasignarlas. “La lucha por la tierra nos hizo crear una identidad de unión, de cooperación y de trabajo mutuo, de ayuda entre las personas, que es fundamental en nuestro trabajo”, cuenta Krupinski, que este año viajó fuera de Brasil, por primera vez, para visitar las

experiencias productivas de la Federación Rural

.


Foto: Rafa Dotti


Organización cooperativa para la producción


La organización de 600 familias en 35 asentamientos es un desafío cooperativo que se organiza con un representante cada cinco o quince familias productoras para representarlas en las asambleas de toma de decisiones. Cada familia cuenta con alrededor de diez hectáreas para la producción de arroz y hortalizas, en su mayoría, pero también ganado lechero, frutas y peces.


Organizar esa producción también fue un aprendizaje, cuenta Krupinski, porque las familias sin tierra eran del norte de Río Grande do Sul, donde cultivaban porotos, soja y maíz, y las tierras las consiguieron en el sur del estado …

author: Unknown
title: Trump'ın Kasım ara seçimleri oyunu bozuldu: Yüksek Mahkeme "mektupla oy kullanmaya eskisi gibi devam" dedi
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump’ın mektupla oy kullanımını zorlaştırmaya yönelik girişimi Yüksek Mahkeme’nin engeline takıldı. Mahkeme, yönetimin ABD Posta İdaresi (USPS) üzerinden getirmek istediği yeni koşulları durduran alt mahkeme kararının kaldırılması talebini reddetti. Böylece düzenleme 2026 ara seçimlerinden önce yürürlüğe giremeyecek. 


Karar, mektupla oy kullanımına ilişkin davayı bütünüyle sonuçlandırmıyor. Yüksek Mahkeme bu aşamada düzenlemenin nihai olarak Anayasa'ya ya da federal yasalara uygun olup olmadığı konusuna girmeyi reddetti. Mahkeme, yönetimin seçim süreci başlamışken yeni kuralları uygulamaya koymasına izin vermedi.


Trump Yüksek Mahkemeye saldırdı 


Trump, Yüksek Mahkeme’nin kararına sert tepki gösterdi. Mahkeme’nin “Radikal Sol’un baskısına boyun eğdiğini” ileri süren Trump, son dönemde bazı kararların ABD’ye büyük zarar verdiğini savundu.


Trump’ın eleştirilerinin hedefinde, ilk başkanlık döneminde kendisinin Yüksek Mahkeme’ye atadığı Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh ve Amy Coney Barrett da vardı. Buna karşılık, yönetimin mektupla oy düzenlemesinin uygulanmasından yana görüş bildiren Clarence Thomas ve Samuel Alito’yu övdü.


Trump’ın mahkeme kararını kınaması oy kullanma tartışmasının ötesine taşıdı. ABD Başkanı, talebini reddeden ve aralarında kendi atadığı üyelerin de bulunduğu Yüksek Mahkeme çoğunluğunu siyasi baskıya teslim olmakla suçladı.


Trump daha önce de aleyhine karar veren federal yargıçları ve mahkemeleri sert biçimde hedef almıştı. Ancak son açıklaması, 6’ya 3 muhafazakâr çoğunluğa sahip ve üç üyesini bizzat kendisinin atadığı Yüksek Mahkeme’yle ve hukuk devleti ilkesiyle yaşadığı gerilimi özellikle görünür kıldı.


Oyların üçte biri mektupla kullanılıyor


Associated Press’e göre karar sayesinde eyaletler, şimdiye kadar kullandıkları usullerle seçmenlere mektupla oy pusulası göndermeyi sürdürebilecek. Mektupla kullanılan oy miktarı son seçimlerde ABD’de kullanılan oyların yaklaşık üçte birini oluşturuyordu.  


Tartışmanın kaynağında, Trump’ın Mart’ta yayımladığı seçim kararnamesinin ardından ABD Posta İdaresi’nin (USPS) 21 Ağustos’ta açıkladığı yeni düzenleme var. 


Buna göre, eyaletlerden mektupla oy pusulası gönderilecek seçmenlere ilişkin listeleri Posta İdaresi’ne iletmeleri ve USPS tarafından onaylanan, özel barkod taşıyan zarfları kullanmaları isteniyordu. Koşullara uymayan seçim postalarının Posta İdaresi tarafından kabul edilmemesi mümkün olabilirdi. 


Eyaletler ve oy hakkı örgütleri, seçim takvimi başladıktan sonra ülke çapında yeni bir sistem kurulmasının ciddi aksamalara yol açacağını, kurallara uygun biçimde oy kullanmak isteyen seçmenlerin pusulalarının gönderilememesi veya geri çevrilmesi tehlikesi bulunduğunu ileri sürerek karara itiraz etti. 


Trump yönetimi ise düzenlemeyi, seçim güvenliğini artıracak ve posta yoluyla oy kullanımında ülke çapında standartlar oluşturacak bir önlem olarak savundu. 


İki federal yargıç düzenlemeyi durdurdu


Trump yönetiminin girişimi Yüksek Mahkeme’ye ulaşmadan önce iki ayrı federal mahkeme tarafından durduruldu.


Boston’daki Federal Bölge Mahkemesi Yargıcı Indira Talwani, yeni posta kurallarının 2026 ara seçimlerinde uygulanmasını engelledi. Talwani seçimlerin yönetiminde eyaletlere tanınan anayasal yetkileri ve seçim takviminin ulaştığı aşamayı dikkate aldı.


Bir federal temyiz mahkemesi de 10 Eylül’de Trump yönetiminin Talwani’nin kararını kaldırma talebini reddetti. 


Ardından Washington’daki Federal Bölge Mahkemesi Yargıcı Carl Nichols da düzenlemeyi durdurdu. Trump’ın ilk başkanlık döneminde atadığı Nichols, Posta İdaresi’nin Kongre’den açık bir yetki almadan mektupla oy kullanmaya böylesine kapsamlı koşullar getiremeyeceğine karar verdi. 


Trump yönetimi bunun üzerine Yüksek Mahkeme’ye başvurarak Talwani’nin kararının acilen kaldırılmasını ve yeni kuralların kasım seçimlerinde uygulanmasına izin verilmesini istedi.


Yüksek Mahkemeden red 


Konuyu ele alan Yüksek Mahkeme üyelerinden yargıçlar Clarence Thomas ve Samuel Alito yönetimin talebinin kabul edilmesinden yana görüş bildirdiler. Yargıç Brett Kavanaugh ise Posta İdaresi’nin gelecekte seçim postası konusunda bazı düzenlemeler yapma yetkisinin bulunabileceğini belirtmekle birlikte, seçim başladıktan sonra kuralların değiştirilmesinin yaratacağı sorunları gerekçe göstererek bu aşamada yönetimin talebine katılmadığını belirtti. Diğer üyeler Trump'ın talebini reddetti. 


Karar özellikle zamanlaması bakımından önemli. Bazı eyaletlerde seçmenlere oy pusulalarının …

author: Trojka
title: 3 października, Toruń – DEMONSTRACJA PRZECIWKO KSENOFOBII – NASZE ULICE, WASZE GRANICE
content:
Ksenofobia często przedstawiana jest jako pogląd marginalny, charakterystyczny wyłącznie dla skrajnych środowisk. W rzeczywistości uprzedzenia wobec migrantów i migrantek coraz częściej stają się elementem codziennego języka debaty publicznej, polityki i medialnych narracji. Lęk przed „obcym”, straszenie migracją, terroryzmem, przemocą, chorobami czy utratą miejsc pracy są wykorzystywane do budowania podziałów i kierowania społecznego niezadowolenia przeciwko tym, których najłatwiej wskazać jako winnych.


Nie zgadzamy się na świat, w którym człowiek oceniany jest przez pryzmat miejsca urodzenia, pochodzenia, koloru skóry, języka, dokumentów czy posiadanego obywatelstwa. Nie zgadzamy się na dzielenie ludzi na „swoich” i „obcych”, na tych, którym należy się bezpieczeństwo, godność i prawa, oraz tych, których można pozbawić ich tylko dlatego, że przekroczyli granicę.


Nasza demonstracja jest częścią kampanii „Nasze ulice, wasze granice”, prowadzonej wspólnie przez Federację Anarchistyczną i 161 Crew. Kampania skupia się na problemie dyskryminacji migrantów i migrantek oraz na sposobach, w jakie państwo i jego instytucje zarządzają migracją, wykorzystując do tego dyskurs antagonizmu, strachu i supremacji etnicznej.


Chcemy mówić nie tylko o pojedynczych przypadkach przemocy czy dyskryminacji, ale przede wszystkim o ich systemowych źródłach. O przepisach, procedurach i instytucjach, które utrudniają ludziom funkcjonowanie, podejmowanie pracy, organizowanie się i walkę o swoje prawa. O ograniczeniach, które sprawiają, że migrantki i migranci są szczególnie narażeni na wyzysk, zależność i przemoc. O tym, że nierówność nie zaczyna się i nie kończy na ulicznym wyzwisku — jest również zapisana w prawie, polityce migracyjnej i sposobie organizowania naszego wspólnego życia.


Podsycanie lęku przed Innym nie jest nowym sposobem sprawowania władzy. Straszenie „migrantami”, którzy mają rzekomo zabierać pracę, podnosić ceny mieszkań, odpowiadać za pogarszającą się jakość życia czy stanowić zagrożenie dla bezpieczeństwa, pozwala odwrócić uwagę od rzeczywistych przyczyn problemów społecznych. Zamiast pytać, dlaczego coraz więcej osób nie może pozwolić sobie na mieszkanie, dlaczego praca staje się coraz bardziej niepewna, dlaczego rosną nierówności i dlaczego coraz trudniej o dostęp do podstawowych usług, wskazuje się kolejne grupy, które mają ponosić za to odpowiedzialność.


Nie kupujemy tej opowieści! Problemem nie są ludzie, którzy przemieszczają się w poszukiwaniu bezpiecznego i godnego życia. Problemem jest system, który wykorzystuje ich niepewną sytuację, aby łatwiej ich kontrolować i eksploatować.


Nie chcemy świata opartego na strachu i podejrzliwości.


Chcemy świata, w którym prawa człowieka nie zależą od paszportu. W którym żadna osoba nie jest traktowana jako mniej wartościowa dlatego, że urodziła się po drugiej stronie granicy. W którym miejsce urodzenia nie decyduje o tym, czy można legalnie pracować, mieszkać, organizować się i żyć bez ciągłego strachu przed deportacją.


Nasza odpowiedź na politykę strachu to solidarność. Na podziały odpowiadamy współpracą. Na nacjonalistyczne hasła odpowiadamy przekonaniem, że żadne granice nie powinny decydować o wartości człowieka.


Zapraszamy wszystkich i wszystkie, którym nie jest obojętne, jak wygląda nasze wspólne życie. Zapraszamy osoby, które sprzeciwiają się rasizmowi i ksenofobii, osoby działające na rzecz praw człowieka, pracownic i pracowników, migrantów i migrantek, osoby zaangażowane społecznie oraz wszystkich tych, którzy uważają, że solidarność jest silniejsza niż podziały.


NASZE ULICE, WASZE GRANICE.

RÓWNE PRAWA DLA WSZYSTKICH.

SWOBODA PRZEMIESZCZANIA SIĘ.

3 PAŹDZIERNIKA

author: anred
title: «AySA no se privatiza, el agua no es una mercancía
content:
Hoy numerosas agrupaciones ambientales, sindicales, sociales y partidarias se convocaron frente al Ministerio de Economía para denunciar el llamado a licitación de AySA por parte del gobierno nacional que pretende transformar un servicio público en un negociado de unos pocos, en oposición a las normativas nacionales e internacionales que declaran al agua como un derecho humano.


Por Patricia Rodríguez para ANRed 


Esta mañana, a las 9.30, las organizaciones socioambientales y territoriales nucleadas en el Foro Hídrico y Ambiental de Lomas de Zamora convocan a una movilización frente al Ministerio de Economía (Hipólito Yrigoyen 250, CABA) contra la privatización de AySA. La protesta tuvo lugar el mismo día en que vencía el plazo para la presentación de ofertas por el 90% de las acciones de la empresa que permanecen en manos del Estado nacional.


Con las consignas «No a la privatización de AYSA», «No a la reducción de controles de la calidad del agua» y «No a las tarifas abusivas ni al corte de agua por falta de pago», las organizaciones vuelven a poner en el centro la defensa del acceso al agua potable y el saneamiento como derechos, mientras cuestionan las condiciones del proceso privatizador y la participación de la empresa israelí Mekorot como asesora.


Además, pese a la medida cautelar dictada por la Defensoría del Pueblo bonaerense que ordenaba no innovar, hoy se abrieron los sobres electrónicos de la primera etapa de la licitación y quedaron confirmados dos consorcios, Rowing-Arcos-Transclor-PHX, y Roggio.


Mauricio Filiberti, dueño de Transclor, el proveedor del insumo más importante que consume AySA, el cloro, es, además, socio de José Luis Manzano y de Daniel Vila accionistas de Edenor. Por lo tanto, Aysa, principal cliente de Edenor constituirían ambas empresas un monopolio que manejaría la electricidad y el agua del Amba.

author: Keelan Jacobs
title: Anishinabek Nation tells Carney summit resources ‘are not theirs to give’
content:
As Prime Minister Mark Carney wraps up the first investment summit with investors from around the world, the Anishinabek Nation has a warning for the government.


“The lands and resources being targeted for development and investment are within the treaty territories of the Anishinabek First Nations around the Great Lakes region,” said Grand Council Chief Linda Debassige in a statement.


“As with the first European contact, the Governments of Canada and Ontario, along with investors, continue to fail to recognize our Nation’s sovereignty over lands and resources.


Carney’s two-day gathering brought federal and provincial ministers, leading global investors, Canadian CEOs and public-sector representatives and was focused on accelerating new investments into Canada.


“At the first Canada Investment Summit, we unleashed nearly $500 billion of new investment into Canada,” Carney said in his closing speech at the summit. “That means more good jobs for our workers. Major new opportunities for our businesses. Canada is boldly unleashing our potential — and we are just getting started.”


But Debassige called out the government for its “continued failure to respect our Nations’ inherent rights and the treaties.


“First Nations will continue to demand justice, respect, and the fulfillment of the Crown’s constitutional and treaty obligations to the original relationship. Trust must be built before any investment can be made in our territories,” she said.


Anishinabek Grand Council Chief Linda Debassige is pictured appearing before the Senate committee on human rights earlier this year. Photo: APTN.


Debassige tied that warning to the royal investment that first commercialized the region.


In 1670, Debassige said, the Crown King Charles II of England – issued a Royal Charter to create the Hudson’s Bay Company. Backed by that investment, the company established remote trading posts and built long-term commercial relationships with First Peoples that relied on trust to supply European demand for beaver-pelt hats.


“Governments and investors must understand that, just as it was in 1670, these resources belong to our Nations; certainty is only assumed,” she said.


Access to Anishinabek land and resources “begins with our trust,” Debassige said, and projects must foster meaningful, respectful relationships for sustainable investment.


She called on all governments to “move beyond the ignorance of our Nation’s inherent rights,” and further said the prime minister is “brokering deals involving our Nation’s resources overseas and without our Nations.”


At the first Canada Investment Summit, we unleashed nearly $500 billion of new investment into Canada. That means more good jobs for our workers. Major new opportunities for our businesses.


Canada is boldly unleashing our potential — and we are just getting started.

pic.twitter.com/Yd9yJr7lnV


— Mark Carney (@MarkJCarney)

September 15, 2026


That charge echoed a separate warning issued Monday by the Anishnabe Nation of Lac Simon in Quebec.


The council said the proposed Kino Aski liquefied natural gas project — a pipeline that would move gas from Western Canada to Baie–Comeau on Quebec’s North Shore for export to Europe “currently lacks both community consent and significant social acceptance.”


Chief Lucien Wabanonik said the project “has not been approved and must, without fail, obtain the free, prior and informed consent of the Anishnabe Nation of Lac Simon and the other affected First Nations — which is not currently the case.” The council told potential investors and Ottawa that consent “cannot be presumed, circumvented, or replaced by discussions conducted without the full and meaningful participation of the many affected First Nations.”


Debassige called on Carney to demonstrate the Crown’s meaningful commitment to upholding the Honour of the Crown, upholding the treaty relationships, upholding the principles of reconciliation, and respect for the sovereignty of the many Nations of the Anishinabek Nation.


Read More: 


Lac Simon warns LNG project requires First Nations consent 


The Anishinabek Nation said it stands ready to work collaboratively, provided that adequate, equitable economic development occurs with its communities, that respects and supports environmental integrity and advances true reconciliation.


“It is time for Canada to recognize that our resources on our lands are not theirs to give or to barter away to attract investment, but belong …

title: Macklemore’un kesilmesine tepki: Ed Sheeran’ın ABD turnesindeki tüm ön gruplar çekildi
content:
Ed Sheeran’ın ABD turnesindeki tüm ön gruplar, rapçi Macklemore’un sahnede Filistin yanlısı açıklamalar yapmasının ardından turne kadrosundan çıkarılmasını protesto ederek çekildi.

Turneden ayrılan isimler arasında Finneas, Aaron Rowe, Lukas Graham ve Sheeran’a sahnede eşlik eden İrlandalı folk grubu Beoga bulunuyor. Finneas, “Sanatçılar, ezilenler için seslerini yükselttiklerinde susturulmamalı,” açıklamasını yaptı.

Açıklamalar, Sheeran’ın Gazze konusunda kamuoyu önünde yürütülecek bir tartışmanın içine çekilmeyeceğini söylemesinden ve Macklemore’un turneden çıkarılmasından kendisinin sorumlu olmadığını iddia etmesinden saatler sonra geldi.

Macklemore, New Jersey’deki iki konserde “Özgür Filistin” çağrısında bulunmuş ve Gazze’deki yıkımı gösteren görüntüler yayımlamıştı. Açıklamaların bazı Yahudi kuruluşların tepkisini çekmesinin ardından kimi konser mekanlarının organizatörlere baskı yaptığı belirtildi. Macklemore, bu isimler arasında NFL takımı New England Patriots'ın ve Gillette Stadyumu'nun sahibi milyarder Robert Kraft'ın bulunduğunu belirtti.

Sheeran, Macklemore’un turneden çıkarılmasının kendisinin değil organizatör Messina Touring Group’un kararı olduğunu söyledi. İsrail-Filistin çatışmasından “dehşete düştüğünü” belirten İngiliz şarkıcı, konserlerini siyasi bir platform olarak kullanmamayı tercih ettiğini ve kalan konserleri iptal ederek hayranlarını ve turne çalışanlarını yüzüstü bırakmayacağını ifade etti.

author: Unknown
title: MESEM'lilerin aileleri anlatıyor: "İşçinin çocuğu hayata 1-0 yenik başlıyor"
content:
Kaynak: www.gaosb.org sitesinden alınmıştır

Antep – MESEM programı, iş cinayetleri ve gittikçe yaygınlaşan iş kazaları nedeniyle gündemden düşmüyor. Çocuklarını MESEM programına gönderen işçi aileleri, bu seçeneğe mecbur kaldıklarını ve çocuklarıyla gözlemledikleri ağır sömürü koşullarını anlatıyor.

Antep’te konuştuğumuz işçi aileleri, çocuklarının MESEM kapsamındaki işyerlerinde ‘mesleki eğitim’ ismiyle nasıl bir çocuk emeği sömürüsü çarkının işlediğini ortaya koyuyor. Başpınar'da bir fabrikada çalışan işçi, çocuk işçi çalıştırmanın yasak olduğunu ancak bunun MESEM'lileri kapsamadığına dikkat çekiyor: “Benim çocuğun çalıştığı işyerinde MESEM kapsamında çok sayıda çocuk işçi var. Maalesef devletin aldığı yanlış bir karar ve çocuğu okutamayınca biz de böyle bir yola girdik.”

Başpınar’da bir fabrikada çalışan işçi de MESEM'lerdeki çalışma koşullarını kendi çocuğu üzerinden anlatıyor: “15-16 yaşındaki MESEM’li çocuklara yetişkin bir insanın yaptığı işi yaptırıyorlar. Ama paraya gelince aylık 7-8 bin TL veriyorlar, sigorta da yok. Patronlar çocukların yemeğini ve yol parasını da karşılamıyor. Çocuklar 12 saat çalıştırıyor. Yani MESEM’de işverenin kesesinden bir para çıkmıyor. Devlet MESEM’lerle çocukları okumaya teşvik etmek yerine çalışmaya teşvik ediyor.”

İşçi, çocuğunu MESEM'e gönderme gerekçesini ise şöyle açıklıyor: “Bizler çocuklarımızı ne dershaneye gönderebiliyoruz ne de bir özel hoca tutma durumumuz var. İşçinin çocuğu hayata bir sıfır yenik başlıyor. Tüm aile bireylerinin tek düşüncesi ay sonunu getirmek.”

Bir başka işçi ise kızının MESEM’e gidiş sürecini anlatırken, bunun ilk tercihleri olmadığını belirtiyor: “Kızımın okuması için elimden gelenin fazlasını yaptım. Ama benim kızım pek çalışkan olamadı. Geçen dönem lise 1'de sınıfta kaldı. Daha sonra MESEM’de aşçılık bölümüne kayıt yaptırdık. Şimdi haftanın bir günü tatil yapıyor, bir günü okula gidiyor.”

MESEM koşullarını ise şöyle değerlendiriyor: “8 bin TL devlet işverene veriyor. Geri kalan işveren inisiyatifinde. İşveren sigorta yapmıyor. Benim kızımın çalıştığı yerde 7 MESEM öğrencisi var. Okul daha önce bir yere gönderdi kızımı. Güya aşçılık bölümü ama garsonluk yaptırdılar. Gece 5'te eve geldiği oldu. Biz de uykusuz kaldık kızım da. Çok da korktuk, çünkü görüyoruz haberlerde çocuk ölümlerini.”

Çocuğu iki yıldır MESEM kapsamında marangoz atölyesinde çalışan bir işçi ise çocuğunu MESEM'e gönderme sürecini şöyle anlatıyor: “O dönem okuldan çağırdılar, ‘senin çocuğun okumakta gözü yok, MESEM’e yazdır’ dediler. Eskiden ‘çocuklar okusun bizim gibi olmasın’ derdim ama artık MESEM’e yazdırdık. İmkan olmayınca bizim gibi işçi oldu. Belki ileride eli ekmek tutar.”

MESEM kapsamında çalıştırılan çocukların çalıştığı yerlerde hayatını kaybettiği haberleri gördüğünü söyleyen işçi, “O çocukların fotoğraflarını görünce çok kötü oluyorum. Bizim çocuk geliyor aklıma. Korkmuyoruz dersem yalan söylemiş olurum” diyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Report: Trump Transferring $3B Worth of Bombs to Israel, Funded by US Taxpayers
content:
The administration has also notified Congress of a $5 billion sale of bombs to Saudi Arabia.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

The Trump administration is preparing to send a U.S. taxpayer-funded, $3 billion package of 2,000-pound bombs to Israel, the biggest transfer of such weapons in recent years despite the administration’s supposed commitment to maintaining ceasefire agreements across several of Israel’s war fronts.

The package includes 60,000 bombs, split between MK-84s, BLU-117s, and I-2000 “bunker buster” weapons. The transfer is being done through the Foreign Military Financing mechanism, in which the U.S. gives Israel the money to buy the weapons.

The Washington Post reported on the package on Tuesday, citing a U.S. official, and said that Congress has been “informally notified” of it.

The Biden administration halted a single transfer of 2,000-pound bombs to Israel at the height of the genocide in Gaza in 2024, after sending the military thousands of them prior to the pause. President Donald Trump lifted that pause as one of his first acts in office in 2025 — despite warnings that Israel’s frequent use of the bombs in civilian areas amounts to war crimes, and that sending them without conditions could amount to a violation of international and domestic law.

These weapons are extremely destructive. Used extensively by U.S. forces during the Vietnam War, these bombs are capable of creating massive craters on impact and sending shrapnel flying in every direction.

Even smaller bombs have been known to rip bodies apart to tiny shreds when dropped on a population, as Israel has done repeatedly to civilians in its genocide in Gaza, as well as its bombardments of Lebanon and Iran. For instance, researchers found in 2024 that, in the first six weeks of Israel’s genocide in Gaza alone, the military dropped about 600 2,000-pound bombs in the vicinity of hospitals.

Amid the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, Israel reportedly dropped an MK-84 on a densely-populated area of Tehran, killing dozens of civilians; the U.S. also reportedly used the same bomb in an overnight strike on a family home in Iran in July, killing a husband, wife, and their 2-year-old son.

The transfer comes as U.S. officials are claiming that they’re trying to pressure Israel to slow or stop its fighting across multiple fronts. Israel has largely backed out of war on Iran — which the Trump administration dubiously says transformed into a “military conflict” and not a war after the April ceasefire. Trump administration figures have expressed supposed frustration with Israel for repeated violations of U.S.-brokered ceasefire agreements in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria.

Sending a tranche of the much-criticized, highly destructive bombs to the country, however, sends the opposite message. The Trump administration also drew scrutiny when it bypassed Congress to send $4 billion in military assistance to Israel last year.

Meanwhile, the U.S. is adding to the amount of firepower in the Middle East elsewhere, potentially accelerating the destabilization and violence that has been sparked during the Iran war. The State Department notified Congress of a sale of $5 billion of Joint Direct Attack Munitions (JDAMs) to Saudi Arabia last week, as the country was entangled in escalating violence against Yemen’s Houthis, also known as Ansar Allah.

In recent days, the Houthis have seized the country’s Red Sea coastline, while a key Saudi pipeline was struck, sending oil prices soaring. Saudi Arabia has cut oil shipments to Europe as a result of the damage to the pipeline, per Reuters.

The Saudis, who are backing the Yemeni armed forces, have conducted hundreds of airstrikes on Yemen in recent days. The U.S. has sent over 100 military advisers on the ground in Saudi Arabia to support the country in its strikes on Yemen.

author: Unknown
title: Suriye: Şam merkezi yönetimi dayatırken Kürtler anadili kazanımını korumakta ısrarlı
content:
Suriye'de hükümet 2012'den 2025 sonuna kadar ülkenin esasen Kürt otoritesi altında şekillenen kuzeydoğusunda Şam'ın otoritesini yeniden tesis çabalarını artırıken, Kürtler 15 yıla yakın bir dönemde geliştirdikleri eğitim düzeninin temel kazanımlarının başında gelen Kürtçe anadilinde eğitimin sürdürülmesinde ısrarlı. 


Reuters'ın 15 Eylül'de Qamişlo'dan geçtiği habere göre, Şam yönetimi Kürtçeyi “ulusal dil” olarak tanıdı ve Kürt nüfusun yoğun olduğu bölgelerde devlet okullarında okutulmasının önünü açtı. Ancak yeni düzenleme Kürtçeyi bütün derslerin okutulduğu eğitim dili olarak kabul etmiyor.


Yeni sistemde Kürtçe haftada üç ders saati okutulabilecek; tarih, coğrafya, sosyal bilimler ve felsefe gibi bazı dersler Kürtçe verilebilecek. Matematik ve fen bilimlerinin ise Arapça olarak okutulması öngörülüyor.


Kürtçe ders mi, eğitim dili mi?


Anlaşmazlık Kürtçenin varlığının tanınıp tanınmamasında değil, hangi statüyle tanınacağından kaynaklanıyor. 


Baas egemenliğinde eğitimde esamisi okunmayan, kullanımı ağır yaptırımlarla sınırlandırılan Kürtçe, 2012'den sonra Kuzey ve Doğu Suriye'deki özyönetim döneminde kurulan eğitim sisteminde temel dillerden biri hâline gelmişti. Özyönetim, Kürtçenin yanı sıra Arapça ve Süryaniceyi de eğitim dili olarak kabul etmiş, toplulukların anadillerinde eğitim görmesini sistemin temel ilkelerinden biri haline getirmişti.


Kürt eğitim kurumları mevcut entegrasyon sürecinde yeni düzenlemenin Kürtçeyi eğitim dili olmaktan çıkararak bir derse ve sınırlı öğretim dili statüsüne gerilettiğini belirtiyor. Öğrenciler, öğretmenler ve aileler de çeşitli kentlerde Kürtçe eğitimin korunması talebiyle gösteriler düzenledi.


Kuzey ve Doğu Suriye yönetimi liderlerinden İlham Ahmed, Reuters'a Kürtçenin ulusal dil olarak tanınmasını “iyi bir ilk adım” olarak değerlendirdi, ancak Kürt nüfusun yoğun olduğu bölgelerde bütün derslerin Kürtçe okutulabilmesini istediklerini söyledi. Kürt tarafı bu hakkın yeni Suriye Anayasası'nda güvence altına alınmasını talep ediyor.


Şam ise bütün müfredatın Kürtçeye çevrilmesinin, hem öğretmen bulunması hem de öğrencilerin daha sonra Arapça yürütülen üniversite eğitimine geçmeleri bakımından güçlük yaratacağını savunuyor.


Kürt öğretmenler de, yıllardır Kürtçe eğitim gören öğrencilerin bir anda Arapça eğitime geçirilmesindense, en az 1-2 yıllık bir geçiş dönemi istiyor.


938 okul devlet sistemine alındı


Eğitim alanındaki görüşmelerde bazı ilerlemeler sağlandı. Şam Eğitim Bakanlığı, Kuzey ve Doğu Suriye yönetimi döneminde verilen temel eğitim belgelerini tanıdı ve bölgede faaliyet gösteren 938 okulu devlet eğitim sistemine dahil etti.


Böylece Kürt yönetimine bağlı okullarda eğitim gören öğrencilerin diplomalarının tanınması ve devlet okullarıyla üniversitelere geçişlerinin önündeki önemli bir engel kaldırıldı. Ancak eğitimin hangi dilde sürdürüleceği sorunu çözülmeden kaldı. 


Sîpan Hiznî cinayeti güvenlik kaygısını büyüttü


Eğitim tartışması sürerken yaşanan iki ağır güvenlik olayı entegrasyon sürecini tökezletti. 


Şam'la varılan anlaşmalar çerçevesinde Suriye ordusuna katılan eski SDG mensubu Kürt Sîpan Hiznî (Sami Şeyhmus Hiso) Hesekê yakınlarında kaçırılarak öldürüldü.


Kobanî'de 2 günlük yas ilan edildi


13 Eylül 2026


Cinayet, Qamişlo, Hesekê, Dêrik ve Rojava'nın diğer bölgelerinde protestolara yol açtı. Kürt siyasi çevreleri faillerin bulunmasını isterken, Suriye'nin yeni askerî ve güvenlik yapısına katılan Kürtlerin güvenliğinin nasıl sağlanacağı sorunu gündeme yerleşti. 


Suriye makamları, cinayetin baş şüphelisinin belirlendiğini açıklamış olsalar da şüpheli henüz  yakalanarak hakim önüne çıkarılmış değil. 


Kobanê Cezaevi'nde 7 ölüm


Kobanê Cezaevi'nde 12 Eylül'de çıkan isyan ve yangında, Suriye devlet makamlarına göre en az 7 tutuklu öldü. Kürt kaynakları ve sekiz Kürt siyasi partisinin oluşturduğu ittifaksa, aslında 9 kişinin öldüğünü bildirerek bağımsız bir soruşturma talep etti.


Associated Press'in aktardığı bilgilere göre, cezaevi olay sırasında henüz Şam yönetimine devredilmemişti ve Kürt güçlerin kontrolündeydi. Suriye İnsan Hakları Gözlemevi, isyanın bazı tutukluların Halep'teki cezaevlerine nakledileceği haberleri üzerine başladığını bildirdi.


Olay, Kuzey ve Doğu Suriye'deki cezaevleri, mahkemeler ve iç güvenlik kurumlarının Şam'a hangi koşullarda devredileceği sorusunu da gündeme getirdi. İlham Ahmed olayın araştırılması için bir soruşturma komisyonu oluşturulduğunu açıkladı.


Ankara: Fesih sahada da tamamlanmalı

author: infolibre
title: Ο Πέμπτος Παγκόσμιος Πόλεμος έχει ξεκινήσει
content:
Ο ανοιχτός ή λανθάνων πόλεμος που γίνεται όλο και πιο εμφανής, τα φασιστικά συναισθήματα και οι φασιστικές αναπαραστάσεις που εξαπλώνονται όλο και πιο βαθιά, η μοιρολατρία και η απόσυρση στις ταυτότητες που κρύβουν όλο και λιγότερο την αδυναμία: οι καιροί είναι δύσκολοι. Ο

Bernard Aspe

 προτείνει εδώ μια σύνθεση της τρέχουσας κατάστασης των δυνάμεων, όχι για να σχολιάσει την εν εξελίξει ήττα, αλλά για να προσδιορίσει τη διαμόρφωση του πεδίου μάχης. Προϋπόθεση κάθε στρατηγικής είναι η ανάπτυξη μιας κοινής αντίληψης, η οποία να περιλαμβάνει όλες τις ιδιαιτερότητες και τις διαφωνίες που τη χαρακτηρίζουν.


«

 

Αν την παρατηρούσαμε από τον Γαλαξία μας, η Γη, ερειπωμένη, καμένη, να περιστρέφεται, μαύρη και έρημη, μέσα στο σύμπαν, δεν θα μπορούσε να μας είναι πιο ξένη (…)


και όμως, η παιδική ηλικία που περάσαμε εκεί, είναι σχεδόν σαν να ήταν χθες.

 

»


Sebald


ΜΙΑ

 Ε

ΙΚΟΝΑ


Το 1997, αυτός που τότε ονομαζόταν

υποδιοικητής Μάρκος

 έγραψε το κείμενο

«Ο Τέταρτος Παγκόσμιος Πόλεμος έχει ξεκινήσει»

 [1]. Ο Ψυχρός Πόλεμος είχε λήξει λίγα χρόνια νωρίτερα, και αμέσως τον διαδέχθηκε ένας νέος παγκόσμιος πόλεμος, με διακύβευμα, όπως και σήμερα, ο έλεγχος της παγκόσμιας οικονομίας. Το κείμενο του Μάρκος αποσκοπούσε στην περιγραφή της νεοφιλελεύθερης διακυβέρνησης, ως πόλεμος εναντίον ολόκληρης της ανθρωπότητας. Από καθαρά στρατιωτική άποψη, το ιστορικό πλαίσιο ήταν επίσης ο πρώτος πόλεμος του Κόλπου, το 1991, στιγμή κατά την οποία άρχισαν να αναφέρονται στις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες ως «αστυνομία του κόσμου».

Ο τρίτος παγκόσμιος πόλεμος είχε διακοπεί με την κατάρρευση του σοβιετικού μπλοκ·

 κατά τον

τέταρτο, δεν υπήρχαν πλέον μεγάλα εχθρικά μπλοκ

 που να αντιμάχονται το ένα το άλλο, αλλά υπήρχε πρωτίστως μια δύναμη που έπρεπε να αναλάβει να αποτελέσει, μόνη της, τον δομικό πυρήνα της παγκόσμιας τάξης. Τα κύρια μέσα της ήταν η στρατιωτική δύναμη, το νόμισμα, η πολιτιστική ηγεμονία και, με την πάροδο των δεκαετιών, η διείσδυση στις καθημερινές δραστηριότητες, «εντός» και «εκτός» εργασίας, ιδίως μέσω της ψηφιακής προόδου.


Η περιγραφή που πρότεινε ο Μάρκος φαίνεται πλέον να αντιστοιχεί σε μια εποχή που απομακρύνεται, φυσικά όχι επειδή ο νεοφιλελευθερισμός υπέκυψε στις επικρίσεις του, αλλά επειδή δεν είναι πλέον προσαρμοσμένος στην επιταχυνόμενη αναδιάρθρωση της παγκόσμιας οικονομίας. Οι μορφές των στρατιωτικών επιχειρήσεων, εκείνες της κυβερνητικότητας και τα τεχνικά μέσα που τις συνοδεύουν παραμένουν, περισσότερο από ποτέ, άρρηκτα συνυφασμένα, αλλά οι ιδιαιτερότητες όπως διαμορφώθηκαν τώρα δεν συνοψίζονται στην ταυτόχρονη εντατικοποίηση των στοιχείων αυτής της σύζευξης. Υπάρχουν πολλά προσχέδια αυτής της διαμόρφωσης· θα αναφερθώ μόνο σε μερικά σημεία αναφοράς για να καταλήξω σε αυτό που μου φαίνεται πιο αποφασιστικό: το σημείο όπου θα διαδραματιστεί η

 υποκειμενοποίηση του πολέμου


ή του αντιπολέμου

 – δηλαδή της πολιτικής που ακόμη στερείται συγκεκριμένης συνοχής, αλλά η οποία, λογικά, θα πρέπει να διαμορφωθεί από εδώ και στο εξής.


Δεν διεκδικώ καμία πρωτοτυπία, καθώς ο στόχος εδώ είναι να γίνει μια σύνθεση (να έχουμε «μια συνοπτική εικόνα», όπως έλεγε ο

Wittgenstein

), της οποίας ίσως θα εκτιμήσουμε τη σημασία στην τελευταία ενότητα. Θα προσθέσω όμως ότι το γεγονός πως τόσοι πολλοί άνθρωποι προσπαθούν σήμερα να πουν περίπου το ίδιο πράγμα μου φαίνεται μάλλον θετικό. Υπήρξε μια εποχή κατά την οποία εκτιμούσαμε χωρίς μέτρο την εξαιρετική μοναδικότητα της έκφρασης, αλλά κι αυτό οι εχθροί μας κατάφεραν να το μετατρέψουν σε παγίδα.


Η ΠΑΓΚΟΣΜΙΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΤΟΥ ΠΟΛΕΜΟΥ


Γίνεται μεγάλη συζήτηση για τις νέες μορφές του πολέμου – δεν πρόκειται για πρόσφατη μόδα, ας πούμε ότι έχει αναζωπυρωθεί. Αλλά πρέπει πρώτα να υπενθυμίσουμε σε ποιο πλαίσιο διαμορφώνεται αυτή η καινοτομία. Ο παγκόσμιος πόλεμος δεν αναφέρεται τόσο σε ένα γεγονός ή μια σειρά γεγονότων, όσο σε ένα συνεχές κλίμα αβεβαιότητας, μια αδύνατη επιστροφή σε μια «αληθινή» ειρήνη, το οποίο εμφανίστηκε ως τέτοιο το 1914 και δεν έχει σταματήσει να επιβάλλεται εδώ και έναν αιώνα. Στο έργο του για τον «σύντομο εικοστό αιώνα», ο

Eric Hobsbawm

 γράφει:

«“Ειρήνη” σήμαινε “πριν από το 1914”: μετά από αυτό επήλθε κάτι που δεν μπορούσε πλέον να αξίζει αυτό το όνομα»

.

Μετά το 1914, η ειρήνη δεν είναι πλέον δυνατή, επειδή η αντιπαλότητα μεταξύ των δυνάμεων στη διαμόρφωση της παγκόσμιας οικονομίας δεν μπορεί πλέον να σταματήσει, και επειδή αυτή η αντιπαλότητα είναι πάντα καταδικασμένη να παίρνει, κάποια στιγμή και για περισσότερο ή λιγότερο μεγάλες περιόδους, τη μορφή του …

author: Daron Letts
title: Public housing waitlist grew by one applicant per day in 2025, says Igluvut manager
content:
By the time the four-day Nunavut Trade Show wraps up in Iqaluit on Thursday, four more applicants will have been added to the territory’s housing wait list.


That’s because, last year, the housing waitlist grew by 365 applicants, says Aaron Pederson, project manager of housing and homelessness with Igluvut Corp., Nunavut Tunngavik Inc.’s housing non-profit.


“That’s one more family every single day,” he said.


That is one of several sobering statistics Pederson cited during Tuesday’s mid-morning panel discussion, “Building our territorial infrastructure”. The panel also featured Qikiqtaaluk Corp. President and CEO Harry Flaherty, Nukik Corp. senior project advisor Tom Garrett, and Kitikmeot Corp. President and CEO David Omilgoitok.


“In a territory with fewer than 10,000 occupied homes, the line for a house is more than 1/3 the length of the entire housing stock,” Pederson said.


Of the new homes being built, close to 95 per cent are public housing.


“Nationally, it’s six percent,” he said.


Of the 61 per cent of Nunavummiut who live in public housing, 45 per cent live in overcrowded dwellings, he added.


Pederson suggested that those in charge of industrial projects “can’t staff positions from an overcrowded home.”


Igluvut, whose operations launched in April, provides an alternative housing model, he said.


The organization owns, operates and maintains affordable housing for Inuit that isn’t tied to a job, and with fixed rent that’s not tied to income.


The organization is backed by a $135 million Inuit Housing Fund, which includes $63 million from the repayment of a Nunavut Agreement Negotiation Loan, along with $72 million from the 2022 federal budget.


“The model is simple,” Pederson said.


Inuit associations build the homes, and Igluvut takes over to manage and maintain them.


Igluvut’s first 21, three-bedroom homes are being finished this fall in Pond Inlet, Arctic Bay, Clyde River and Grise Fiord.


Nine more units are earmarked for Igloolik.


Of the 750 homes pledged to be built in the territory through the $250 million from the federal Build Canada Homes program, Igluvut will manage 25 through its housing model, Pederson said, adding that NTI is working on a proposal for 400 more.

author: Chris Walker
title: Describing Himself as a “Hoax Buster,” Trump Dismisses Legitimate AI Concerns
content:
Tech experts say that AI companies can’t be trusted to self-regulate.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

In Truth Social posts on Monday, President Donald Trump downplayed concerns about artificial intelligence (AI), calling criticism of its unregulated expansion a “hoax,” even as experts warn about the speed at which the technology is growing.

The president’s post cited imagery reminiscent of sci-fi movies, rather than referencing the ways in which AI is already being used in warfare and to invade individuals’ privacy rights.

“AI taking over the World, destroying Humanity, and all other things bad, is a HOAX,” Trump wrote in his first post, “no different from RUSSIA, RUSSIA, RUSSIA — UKRAINE, UKRAINE, UKRAINE — IMPEACHMENT HOAX #1 — IMPEACHMENT HOAX #2 — and all of the other HOAXES and SCAMS that America was forced to endure.”

Notably, all of those items (the Russia investigation and potential charges Trump could have faced from it, the impeachment due to Trump’s leveraging aid to Ukraine for political dirt on former President Joe Biden, and his second impeachment due to the attack on the Capitol on January 6, 2021) were not “hoaxes.”

In his second post, Trump reiterated his claim that warnings about AI were “hoaxes,” this time referencing the climate crisis, which is also not a hoax.

“I am the Hoax Buster, and I’m right now breaking another Hoax — That AI is going to take over, consume, and destroy the World, and that Robots will be marching into our Cities, and getting rid of us all!” Trump wrote.

The posts came just one day after Trump dismissed the public push for AI to be regulated, labeling such calls as “treasonous.”

“The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump said.

Other Republicans have similarly dismissed concerns about AI. On Tuesday, Speaker of the House Mike Johnson (R-Louisiana) attempted to explain to reporters what Trump meant by the word “hoax.”

“When the president says ‘a hoax,’ what he’s referring to is, we’ve all seen this movie before. A catastrophe is created. The media gets spun up. Social media gets spun up. Everybody says we’re all … going to be dead in 10 years,” Johnson said. “What the president is saying is you’re not all going to be dead in 10 years. That’s a hoax.”

The recent comments from Johnson and Trump downplay serious warnings from former scientists and workers at these companies. Though some of the companies peddling and profiting off of AI have recently said that the development of the technology should be slowed down, they have advocated for self-regulation rather than government oversight.

Evan Greer, director of the digital rights group Fight for the Future, disagrees with that approach.

“We can’t trust the AI industry to regulate itself,” Greer said in a recent statement, adding:

We can’t really trust anything these self-interested billionaires say. But we should take them seriously that the technology they are building is dangerous. And we should act urgently to demand strict regulation that protects people and holds AI companies accountable for the harm they’ve already done, while also preventing future harm.

“It’s clear that these industry leaders think they are best positioned to craft AI policy for the good of all humanity. We think that’s horseshit,” Greer added, calling on lawmakers to listen to “independent experts, researchers, civil society, and the communities most impacted” by AI’s expansion.

“Whether humans use AI to kill each other or AI agent swarms do immense harm, it’s clear that unregulated AI poses an existential threat to human rights and liberty, if not humanity itself,” she continued. “Congress should act, but they shouldn’t just do whatever the AI bros tell them to.”

author: Amy Goodman
title: Modern-Day Fascism Isn’t a Rerun — It Is “End Times Fascism”
content:
A new book examines how wealthy elites are preparing for “the end of the world” even as they drive growing crises.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor launch their new book, End Times Fascism: And the Fight for the Living World on Democracy Now! It examines how wealthy elites are preparing for “the end of the world,” even as they contribute to growing inequality, political instability and the climate crisis. The rise of modern-day fascism is “not simply a rerun,” explains Klein. “We don’t believe that history repeats on a loop. We believe that we’re in something more like a sequel, where the logics of fascism, which are the logics of dehumanization, of othering, of racial supremacy and hierarchy, are now being applied in a time of global existential crisis.” In response, says Taylor, the growing movement seeking to resist this fatalistic vision “fundamentally needs to be grounded in a desire to stay here on Earth, to commit to this place.”

This is a rush transcript. Copy may not be in its final form.

AMY GOODMAN: This is Democracy Now!, Democracynow.org, the War and Peace Report. I’m Amy Goodman in New York joined by Democracy Now! cohost Juan González in Chicago. Hi, Juan.

JUAN GONZÁLEZ: Hi, Amy, and welcome to all of our listeners and viewers across the country and around the world.

AMY GOODMAN: “The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us by the end of the decade.” That was the warning last week from former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon that set off an escalating debate over how to regulate increasingly powerful AI systems. Coxon spoke to the BBC.

COXON: So it’s not at all an exaggeration to say that the people who were involved with both founding these companies and building the tech believe there is a possibility of human extinction. And many of the people who are sort of deep in the weeds on actually coding the thing believe that there is like a greater than 10% chance or even greater—some smaller, but they all have different numbers—for a probability that humans might die. And they all keep this in their head on a daily basis while working on the technology.

AMY GOODMAN: Anthropic’s CEO Dario Amodei also called for the pace of development of artificial intelligence models to slow down. In an essay, he wrote that within six to 12 months a swarm of AI agents could be capable of taking over the entire internet and cause hundreds of billions of dollars in damage. He wrote, “The scale of damage would continue to increase from there if AI becomes more powerful without the necessary guardrails.” But President Trump has rejected growing calls for placing regulatory guardrails on the AI industry and has called concerns over AI a “hoax.” On Monday, Trump called Jensen Huang, the CEO of the computer chip maker Nvidia, while Huang was speaking at an AI summit in Los Angeles. Huang put the president on speakerphone.

PRES. TRUMP: The data centers are great and they make people wealthy and they make states wealthy and it’s the oil of the next 20, 25 years. It’s bigger than the Internet. And the AI, you know, much more so. And they are just playing right into the hands of a lot of people that don’t want to see it happen. And that could be political people; it could also be China. And we’re not going to let that happen. It’s a hoax. And [crosstalk]—

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Massie Moves to Force Impeachment Vote Against Hegseth, Citing Civilian Deaths
content:
The Republican lawmaker cited incidents like the US’s elementary school massacre in Minab, Iran, early in the war.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Kentucky) has moved to force an impeachment vote against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, introducing eight articles on the House floor accusing Hegseth of high crimes and misdemeanors on Tuesday.

Massie’s measure is privileged, meaning that the House will be forced to vote on it by Thursday. With Republicans in charge of the House, the articles are unlikely to pass — but it will get lawmakers on the record on Hegseth and the administration’s vastly unpopular, multi-front conflicts.

The articles cite the “illegal war” on Iran; the U.S.’s military campaigns in Venezuela, Yemen, and its boat strike campaign; Hegseth’s apathy toward avoiding civilian harm; and his efforts to suppress the speech of his critics.

“By engaging in hostilities in Iran for more than 90 days without congressional authorization, Secretary Hegseth is breaking the law and must be held accountable,” said Massie in a statement. “Secretary Hegseth’s constitutional violations extend beyond the illegal war in Iran. He is abusing the power of his office to ignore congressional war powers resolutions, to kidnap foreign leaders, and to intimidate critics of the Trump administration by retaliating against them for exercising free speech.”

The measure is the most expansive effort yet by any lawmaker to impeach Hegseth. A previous effort by Rep. Yassamin Ansari (D-Arizona) also cited the Iran war, but was not introduced in a privileged manner and thus did not get a vote in the GOP-controlled House.

On Iran, Massie accuses Hegseth of violating three provisions within the War Powers Resolution of 1973 by waging the war without the approval of Congress at three different points: at its inception, after the administration blew through a key 60-day deadline without congressional approval, and after Congress passed a resolution directing the U.S. to withdraw troops in June.

Massie specifically calls out the U.S.’s strike on an elementary school in Minab, Iran, citing it as an example of Hegseth “ignoring laws that minimize civilian casualties.” That strike killed 168 people, most of them young school children, in one of the single most deadly attacks on civilians in recent U.S. history.

“Secretary Hegseth also cultivated a war-making culture at the Department of Defense which he boasts as being dismissive of ‘stupid rules of engagement’ with preference for ‘maximum lethality, not tepid legality,’” the impeachment article says. “By directing the Department of Defense in a manner that foreseeably dismantled the safeguards necessary to distinguish civilian objects from military objectives, Secretary Hegseth thereby effected the murder of civilians.”

One article each is dedicated to the U.S.’s “extrajudicial killings” in the boat strike campaign in the Caribbean Sea and eastern Pacific Ocean; the “kidnapping” of then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro; and the “unlawful” war on Yemen. On Yemen, Massie cites messages from the leaked Signal chat to demonstrate that the military struck Yemen without any immediate threat to the U.S., in an operation that killed over 200 civilians.

Finally, another article charges Hegseth with using his authority to target Sen. Mark Kelly (D-Arizona) over his reminder to U.S. troops of their right to disobey illegal orders. Massie argues that Hegseth, in targeting Kelly, also put at risk the speech of “millions of other retired service members” and a fifth of Congress — which “would constitute one of the most extraordinary expansions of Executive Branch power in the history of the United States” if successful.

author: Maya Schenwar
title: We’re Already Living Through Journalism’s Dystopian Future
content:
AI is devouring our industry and undermining access to factual information. We all have a duty to fight back.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

If you are in San Francisco trying to follow the goings-on in your neighborhood or within city hall, you may have come across The Dissent. The website brands itself as “an AI newsroom” with work “reported, edited, and produced by named agents.” Its founder and publisher Dakota Carrasco — a real person, and, incidentally, an analyst at the notorious investment firm BlackRock — published text on the site’s “about” page saying, “Local journalism has been quietly consolidated and hollowed out.” Carrasco’s statement did not note the role of Carrasco’s own industry in that decline, nor did it acknowledge the irony in choosing this name for a website based on a technology that steals and repackages the intellectual output of others.

The Dissent’s website, which currently appears to be down, even included a masthead with bios for its non-human “staff” (the AI agents whose names appear alongside articles). Neighborhood “reporter” Casey Wong (who is not a real person) has a bio that reads, “I notice the texture of a block — who’s been here 30 years, who’s just moved in.” Of course, there’s no mention of how an AI agent might glean that information, but (actual) news outlet Mission Local has noted that, to fill its pages, The Dissent relies heavily on summarizing the work published in other sites by real human journalists.

Once, The San Francisco Standard reported, The Dissent did appear to follow up on a tip in a Reddit thread to break a story about a business closing, but “the agent appears to have hallucinated the claim that it had reached out to the owner for comment.”

The development of an AI newsroom in San Francisco, which is home to many of the tech billionaires attempting to reshape society, is certainly concerning for those of us who care about journalism. But The Dissent is not the only news outlet to have tried using AI to crib the journalism of real human workers. These AI newsrooms get a decent share of attention, and their harms are critical to point out. But they are also part of a broader problem: the undermining of how we share and receive factual information.

Earlier this year, Google made an announcement that could further destabilize the already precarious journalism industry by using its infamous search feature to prioritize AI summaries from Google Gemini, rather than directing people toward external links to news outlets like ours.

You might not have noticed the deep scale of this change, but you probably have noticed what writer Cory Doctorow refers to as the “enshittification” of Google search — the preponderance of spam, the push toward sponsored results, and the overwhelming sense that the internet no longer works the way it once did.

On June 9, when we sounded the alarm about the increased AI implementation within Google’s search function and the suppression of journalism that would surely result, it was too early to know exactly how much these changes would impact Truthout. Google had announced the changes on May 19 and we were still collecting data.

Before the change, our traffic from Google was 27 percent of our overall traffic: Exactly 2,604,280 people visited Truthout via Google in 2025. Given our experience with Facebook traffic abruptly declining by 90 percent in 2018, following sudden changes in the social media platform’s algorithm (including for example, Facebook’s decision to no longer regularly show Truthout’s posts to the more than 800,000 people who had followed Truthout’s page out of a desire to see them), it seemed reasonable to worry about losing as much as half our Google traffic. In our June op-ed, we wrote, “If even half of that 27 percent disappears, it will have a devastating impact on our journalism.”

At the time, we were hopeful that it wouldn’t be that bad. After all, wasn’t Google’s motto, “Don’t be evil”?

We later learned, however, that Google has quietly stepped back from its infamous motto, even removing it from the opening lines of its Code of Conduct while its parent company, Alphabet, Inc., ignores it entirely.

We now have three full months of data since Google’s change, and the numbers are worse than we anticipated. Overall readership that comes to Truthout through Google is down 54 percent against last year. The number of new readers …

title: Καταρρέει το αφήγημα των βασανιστών του Β. Μάγγου. Νέα συγκέντρωση στην δικάσιμο της Τετάρτης 16/9 11:00 στην Καρδίτσα
content:
ΟΛΟΙ ΚΑΙ ΟΛΕΣ ΣΤΑ ΔΙΚΑΣΤΗΡΙΑ ΚΑΡΔΙΤΣΑΣ ΤΗΝ ΤΕΤΑΡΤΗ 16/09 ΣΤΙΣ 11:00 – ΝΑ ΚΑΤΑΔΙΚΑΣΤΟΥΝ ΟΙ ΒΑΣΑΝΙΣΤΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΒΑΣΙΛΗ


Καταρρέουν τα ψέματα των κατηγορουμένων στη δίκη για τον βασανισμό του Βασίλη Μάγγου. Ο αγώνας για τη δικαίωση του Βασίλη συνεχίζεται. Καλούμε όλο τον κόσμο, τις συλλογικότητες σε μαζική δυναμική παρουσία στην επόμενη δικάσιμο.


Με καταιγιστικές αποκαλύψεις συνεχίστηκε την Τρίτη 07/09 στο Μικτό Ορκωτό Δικαστήριο Καρδίτσας η δίκη των μπάτσων που κατηγορούνται για τον βασανισμό του Βασίλη Μάγγου. Παρά τη γνώριμη, προκλητική και απαράδεκτη στάση των συνηγόρων υπεράσπισης που επιχείρησαν για ακόμη μια φορά να δημιουργήσουν εντυπώσεις, η αλήθεια έλαμψε μέσα από τις ίδιες τις καταθέσεις των μαρτύρων.


Πρώτος στο βήμα του μάρτυρα ανέβηκε σήμερα ο αστυνομικός-σκοπός πύλης της Υ/Α Βόλου κατά την 14η Ιουνίου 2020, ο οποίος είχε κληθεί από την πλευρά της υπεράσπισης. Σε μια απρόσμενη τροπή, ο μάρτυρας ομολόγησε ότι είδε τον Βασίλειο Μάγγο να αποχωρεί από την Ασφάλεια μετά τις 6:00 μ.μ. Η παραδοχή αυτή αποδομεί πλήρως το επίσημο αφήγημα της ΕΛ.ΑΣ., καθώς αποδεικνύει ότι στο Βιβλίο Συμβάντων αναγράφηκε ψευδώς ως ώρα αποχώρησης η 17:10. Επιβεβαιώνονται απόλυτα οι καταθέσεις των αυτοπτών μαρτύρων που δήλωναν εξαρχής ότι βρήκαν τον Βασίλη χτυπημένο έξω από το τμήμα μετά τις 6:00 μ.μ. Οι αστυνομικοί της ΟΠΚΕ Βόλου είπαν ψέματα στις καταθέσεις τους ισχυριζόμενοι ότι είχαν αποχωρήσει πριν τις 5:10 μ.μ. Ο σκοπός πύλης επιβεβαίωσε ότι αποχώρησαν στις 6:00 μ.μ., όπως ακριβώς αναφέρει ο Πίνακας Διάταξης της Υπηρεσίας. Με λίγα λόγια, αποδείχθηκε ότι οι κατηγορούμενοι κρατούσαν παράνομα και βασάνιζαν τον Βασίλη Μάγγο για δύο ολόκληρες ώρες, παρότι γνώριζαν πολύ την ταυτότητά του.


Στη συνέχεια, η κατάθεση της γιατρού που προσέφερε τις πρώτες βοήθειες στον Βασίλη ήρθε να επισφραγίσει το μέγεθος της αγριότητας. Η γιατρός κατέθεσε με σαφήνεια ότι το σώμα του έφερε πολλαπλά χτυπήματα, θλάση στο ήπαρ και στη χοληδόχο κύστη, καθώς και έντονους πόνους στα πλευρά, ενώ μετέφερε στο δικαστήριο την άμεση καταγγελία του ίδιου του Βασίλη:


«Μου είπε ότι τον χτύπησαν αστυνομικοί».


Εκφράζουμε την αλληλεγγύη μας στους συντρόφους του Συντονισμού Συλλογικοτήτων Βόλου που κλήθηκαν να δώσουν εξηγήσεις σε προκαταρκτική έρευνα μετά από μήνυση των 2 εκ των 3 βασανιστών του Βασίλη για “συκοφαντική δυσφήμιση”, ήδη καταδικασμένων από το 2025 στο Βόλο. Άλλο ένα τέχνασμα δικηγορικής αλητείας από τα πολλά που σκαρφίζονται από την αρχή της δίκης οι συνήγοροι τους στην προσπάθεια να επηρεάσουν το κλίμα υπέρ τους και να καλύψουν το ηθικό τους μειονέκτημα, το οποίο μένει και θα μένει διαρκώς ακάλυπτο στην λαϊκή συνείδηση. Περισσότερα στην ανακοίνωση του συντονισμού:


https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1683341153792827&set=a.506553911471563


Τα ψέματα έχουν κοντά ποδάρια και η αλήθεια δεν μπορεί πλέον να κρυφτεί. Απέναντι στις μεθοδεύσεις της δικαστικής εξουσίας και τις προκλητικές στρατηγικές της υπεράσπισης των μπάτσων, η απάντηση δεν είναι ο συμβιβασμός και οι θεσμικές αυταπάτες. Η απάντηση είναι ο ανυποχώρητος, μαχητικός και ανατρεπτικός αγώνας στον δρόμο.


Τα αιτήματα της οικογένειας είναι και δικά μας αιτήματα:


• Να αποδοθούν πλήρως οι ευθύνες για τον βασανισμό και τον θάνατο του Βασίλη.


• Να υπάρξει πραγματικά δίκαιη δίκη χωρίς συγκάλυψη.


• Να καταδικαστούν οι 6 βασανιστές του Βασίλειου Μάγγου.


ΔΕΝ ΞΕΧΝΑΜΕ, ΔΕΝ ΣΥΓΧΩΡΟΥΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΚΡΑΤΙΚΗ ΔΟΛΟΦΟΝΙΑ ΤΟΥ ΒΑΣΙΛΕΙΟΥ ΜΑΓΓΟΥ


ΣΤΟΥΣ ΔΡΟΜΟΥΣ ΑΝΑΠΝΕΕΙ ΤΟ ΔΙΚΙΟ


ΔΕΝ ΥΠΑΡΧΕΙ ΕΙΡΗΝΗ ΧΩΡΙΣ ΔΙΚΑΙΟΣΥΝΗ – ΔΕΝ ΘΑ ΞΕΧΑΣΤΕΙ ΤΙ ΚΑΝΑΝ ΣΤΟΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΗ


Δίκτυο αλληλεγγύης και αγώνα Καρδίτσας – Για υγεία, ζωή και ελευθερία


ΒΑΣΙΛΗΣ ΜΑΓΓΟΣ ΠΑΡΩΝ


Την Τετάρτη 16/09 στις 11:00 όλοι και όλες στα δικαστήρια Καρδίτσας για την συνέχεια της δίκης των ένστολων μισθοφορικών καθαρμάτων του κράτους και βασανιστών του Αναρχικού Βασίλη Μάγγου. Και ας μη νικήσουμε ποτέ θα πολεμάμε πάντα!
